# UTA 旧能力逐项绑定与问题

本附录保留原 MAP/NOTE 身份和问题原文；具体设计以[详细承接正文](legacy-accommodation.md)与[主设计书](../uta-capability-runtime-design.md)为准。绑定数量只用于查漏，不证明架构正确或原生能力已经通过验证。

每条记录都连接原调查、实际源码与所选新关系。原调查中的 K/C/D 引用只在原文语境中保留，不作为新规则编号。

## CoreAccount

| <a id="map-177df827e5"></a>[MAP-177DF827E5](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ACCOUNT-LIFECYCLE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-account-lifecycle) · A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Every test enters through the real UTA constructor and treats TradingGit staging plus SDK Operation as the observable seam.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；保留后果：Retain the vertical intent of constructing a real account around a mock interpreter.；迁移后果：Replace createUTA with a harness that opens a file-backed SQLite/journal fixture and an explicit MockBroker layer; reopen the same fixture for crash/restart scenarios.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1-23。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1-23](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L1-L23) |
| <a id="map-7f92a5f120"></a>[MAP-7F92A5F120](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ACCOUNT-LIFECYCLE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-account-lifecycle) · A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Funded read-only accounts can stage and commit a local proposal; push and a direct TradingGit push both refuse mutation, while keyless implies readOnly and refuses proposal staging.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；保留后果：Preserve asVendor participation as a discovery concern, not as trade authorization.；迁移后果：Replace flag assertions with command/approval tests carrying explicit Actor and AccountScope.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:25-83。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:25-83](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L25-L83) |
| <a id="map-4144027899"></a>[MAP-4144027899](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-SCOPE-ROUTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-scope-routing) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Single implicit broker stages without a selector; a warmed multi-wallet broker refuses missing/unknown/wrong selectors and appends [sub:spot] to a commit message, then clears the tracker between cycles.；本节具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。；保留后果：Retain caller convenience when discovery proves exactly one wallet by resolving it to an explicit sub-account id; preserve instrument-consistency refusal and cycle isolation.；迁移后果：Persist SubAccountRef discovery with connection identity and freshness.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede 任何 live alias/default route 解释：LegacyUtaIdAlias 仅作已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping；DispatchStarted 后不得 reprepare。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:85-153。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:85-153](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L85-L153) |
| <a id="map-189e766e12"></a>[MAP-189E766E12](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Place-order tests spy on direct broker.placeOrder, inspect forwarded SDK fields, treat submitted status as success, and only check rejected length for an error result.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve all order fields that adapters actually support, including precision and contract identity.；迁移后果：Create a MockBroker interpreter that returns explicit Ack and later OrderSnapshot.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:155-246。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:155-246](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L155-L246) |
| <a id="map-f5d4e6c3d4"></a>[MAP-F5D4E6C3D4](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Legacy dispatch reads current positions immediately before close, compares absolute quantity, and uses undefined quantity as full close.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve positive partial/full-close semantics and the no-oversize safety check.；迁移后果：Make quantity decoder and exposure comparison pure; persist snapshot and conflict key.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:247-298。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:247-298](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L247-L298) |
| <a id="map-7a53419830"></a>[MAP-7A53419830](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：The test inserts only orderId into Git, spies on cancelOrder, and maps the returned Cancelled state to submitted.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve cancellation intent and final cancelled projection when broker confirms it.；迁移后果：Build an ExistingOrder fixture with version 3 and fill history.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:299-316。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:299-316](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L299-L316) |
| <a id="map-1fa95f90e8"></a>[MAP-1FA95F90E8](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Modification is represented as an optional-field object and direct broker call; test checks that lmtPrice forwarded but does not inspect prior order.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve callers’ ability to change quantity/price/type/tif where adapter supports them.；迁移后果：Add merge and schema codec tests with DecimalString.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:317-331。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:317-331](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L317-L331) |
| <a id="map-81e9bdac4e"></a>[MAP-81E9BDAC4E](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-OBSERVATION-ACCOUNTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-observation-accounting) · A1, A2, A4, A5, A8 | 保留 | 旧字段/行为：Legacy getState runs account, positions, and getOrders together, mutates contracts with aliceId, and returns a GitState containing only active pending orders.；本节具体目标关系（订单同步、持仓估值与模拟状态）：读取统一为带 scope/as-of/freshness/cursor/coverage 的 Pull Result 或 resource-scoped Push Stream。Stream 的 item-error、gap、snapshot-end 是非 terminal；Completed/Failed/Cancelled 互斥且失败后不可完成。PositionObservation、valuation estimate、FillObservation、order lifecycle 和 simulated state 分开建模；ReconcileBalance 是 valuationOnly/accounting estimate，不是 synthetic FillObservation 或 remote execution claim。 Coverage 只取 Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable；未知值/quality 放在 payload/reason，不增加全局 variant。普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 读取，不需把全部 frame 写入 journal；仅持久化显式 capture、control evidence 与 predicate checkpoint。保留已验证的 same-currency FX identity，并允许显式 policy-approved Estimated display value；删除 unknown=1 或类似伪造，不删除有证据的 1:1/default。；保留后果：Preserve active Submitted and PreSubmitted filtering and realized-PnL fallback as explicit policy.；迁移后果：Create three typed observations with distinct sequence numbers.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede all-data journaling 与 unknown=1/zero fabrication；live query 可带 bound provenance/asOf，Coverage 仅 Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:333-390。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:333-390](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L333-L390) |
| <a id="map-fe83587457"></a>[MAP-FE83587457](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-OBSERVATION-ACCOUNTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-observation-accounting) · A1, A2, A4, A5, A8 | 保留 | 旧字段/行为：Same-base-currency positions are summed to account.unrealizedPnL; any differing currency leaves the broker value unchanged.；本节具体目标关系（订单同步、持仓估值与模拟状态）：读取统一为带 scope/as-of/freshness/cursor/coverage 的 Pull Result 或 resource-scoped Push Stream。Stream 的 item-error、gap、snapshot-end 是非 terminal；Completed/Failed/Cancelled 互斥且失败后不可完成。PositionObservation、valuation estimate、FillObservation、order lifecycle 和 simulated state 分开建模；ReconcileBalance 是 valuationOnly/accounting estimate，不是 synthetic FillObservation 或 remote execution claim。 Coverage 只取 Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable；未知值/quality 放在 payload/reason，不增加全局 variant。普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 读取，不需把全部 frame 写入 journal；仅持久化显式 capture、control evidence 与 predicate checkpoint。保留已验证的 same-currency FX identity，并允许显式 policy-approved Estimated display value；删除 unknown=1 或类似伪造，不删除有证据的 1:1/default。；保留后果：Preserve exact same-currency sum behavior when all evidence is same base currency.；迁移后果：Move tests to accounting projection inputs rather than UTA method spies.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede all-data journaling 与 unknown=1/zero fabrication；live query 可带 bound provenance/asOf，Coverage 仅 Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:392-431。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:392-431](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L392-L431) |
| <a id="map-ba5730be0c"></a>[MAP-BA5730BE0C](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-DATA-CATALOG](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-data-catalog) · A1, A2, A3, A4, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：An aliceId-only native Contract is expanded by resolveNativeKey and copied field-by-field, skipping empty/null/zero/sentinel defaults; nondefault caller exchange survives.；本节具体目标关系（合约目录、报价、历史与 capability evidence）：将 Catalog、Instrument、Quote、Candle、News 与 NewsGroup 作为独立 semantic units。Public/data leaf 使用显式 Public scope；account-authenticated market fact 才带 AccountScope。查询/订阅声明 exact schema、coverage、finality、freshness、cursor/backpressure、source provenance；capability tree 保留 provider open vocabulary，unsupported leaf/alternative 是结构性缺失，已加载但未连接是 typed unavailable。；保留后果：Preserve explicit exchange override and prevention of empty default clobbering.；迁移后果：Add protocol decoder tests for omitted vs explicit fields.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede optional-method/empty-array 伪 Complete；结构缺失、当前 unavailable 与 Partial/Gap 必须分别表达，查询可读 live bound data。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:433-493。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:433-493](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L433-L493) |
| <a id="map-4221233892"></a>[MAP-4221233892](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Loose params select side/orderType and produce one staged placeOrder operation with an SDK Order.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve BUY/SELL and every order form currently accepted by this source leaf as provider-schema examples; do not turn the examples into a closed global set.；迁移后果：Create one typed fixture per variant and one malformed fixture per missing relationship.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:495-532。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:495-532](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L495-L532) |
| <a id="map-27891fcb27"></a>[MAP-27891FCB27](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 保留 | 旧字段/行为：Validation examines optional strings and orderType, throwing Error messages; invalid calls leave Git staging empty.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve all current refusal conditions and empty-string-as-absent semantics.；迁移后果：Add schema/constructor cases for the provider-declared forms and quantity modes; keep future provider forms out of a central order catalogue.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:533-580。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:533-580](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L533-L580) |

| <a id="map-7b3cd75e10"></a>[MAP-7B3CD75E10](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-SCOPE-ROUTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-scope-routing) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A8 | 保留 | 旧字段/行为：A delimiter string is parsed, checked against this.id, resolved by broker, and stamped back onto a mutable Contract; malformed/cross-account cases throw generic Errors.；本节具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。；保留后果：Preserve valid identifier round-trip and loud refusal for malformed/cross-account input.；迁移后果：Add schema decoder and cross-account cases.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede 任何 live alias/default route 解释：LegacyUtaIdAlias 仅作已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping；DispatchStarted 后不得 reprepare。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:774-800。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:774-800](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L774-L800) |
| <a id="map-4303e3e80a"></a>[MAP-4303E3E80A](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Cancel intent enters mutable staging with only an unbranded order id.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve cancel intent and human-readable audit.；迁移后果：Replace status-staged assertion with transaction query and audit projection assertions.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:802-814。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:802-814](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L802-L814) |
| <a id="map-6089771399"></a>[MAP-6089771399](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-JOURNAL-OUTBOX](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-journal-outbox) · A2, A3, A5, A6, A7, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：TradingGit controls Draft/Commit/Push lifecycle; one push may contain multiple operations and successful push empties the staging area.；本节具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。；保留后果：Preserve empty-work refusal and ability to submit several intentional steps.；迁移后果：Map “commit” to Prepare, “push” to Approve plus scheduler admission.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede replayable permission、Git-as-execution 和 DispatchStarted 后 reprepare；持久化的是 authorization/plan evidence，只有 fresh Start 给一次性 process-bound DispatchGrant，duplicate/query Start 只有 AlreadyStarted。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:816-852。 明确取舍：旧 marker 缺失不证明 NoStart；仅 positive no-callback provenance 可退休，缺 native/attempt identity 的 legacy post-push 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才能历史 resolve。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:816-852](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L816-L852) |
| <a id="map-d4f5440582"></a>[MAP-D4F5440582](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-OBSERVATION-ACCOUNTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-observation-accounting) · A1, A2, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Sync maps broker Filled status and filledQuantity/avgFillPrice into a Git sync record; two fills 4@148 and 6@150 become 10@149.2.；本节具体目标关系（订单同步、持仓估值与模拟状态）：读取统一为带 scope/as-of/freshness/cursor/coverage 的 Pull Result 或 resource-scoped Push Stream。Stream 的 item-error、gap、snapshot-end 是非 terminal；Completed/Failed/Cancelled 互斥且失败后不可完成。PositionObservation、valuation estimate、FillObservation、order lifecycle 和 simulated state 分开建模；ReconcileBalance 是 valuationOnly/accounting estimate，不是 synthetic FillObservation 或 remote execution claim。 Coverage 只取 Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable；未知值/quality 放在 payload/reason，不增加全局 variant。普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 读取，不需把全部 frame 写入 journal；仅持久化显式 capture、control evidence 与 predicate checkpoint。保留已验证的 same-currency FX identity，并允许显式 policy-approved Estimated display value；删除 unknown=1 或类似伪造，不删除有证据的 1:1/default。；保留后果：Preserve decimal weighted-average semantics and empty-pending no-op.；迁移后果：Replace fake Git sync commit with observation worker and accounting projector.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede all-data journaling 与 unknown=1/zero fabrication；live query 可带 bound provenance/asOf，Coverage 仅 Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:854-903。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:854-903](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L854-L903) |

| <a id="map-92b40ebfd5"></a>[MAP-92B40EBFD5](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-JOURNAL-OUTBOX](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-journal-outbox) · A2, A3, A5, A6, A7, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：TradingGit serializes its commit log and rehydrates it through constructor savedState.；本节具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。；保留后果：Preserve readable commit/audit history across restart.；迁移后果：Replace savedState fixture with journal restart fixture at Preparing, Prepared, and Leased states.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede replayable permission、Git-as-execution 和 DispatchStarted 后 reprepare；持久化的是 authorization/plan evidence，只有 fresh Start 给一次性 process-bound DispatchGrant，duplicate/query Start 只有 AlreadyStarted。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1083-1101。 明确取舍：旧 marker 缺失不证明 NoStart；仅 positive no-callback provenance 可退休，缺 native/attempt identity 的 legacy post-push 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才能历史 resolve。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1083-1101](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L1083-L1101) |
| <a id="map-b047acc95d"></a>[MAP-B047ACC95D](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ACCOUNT-LIFECYCLE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-account-lifecycle) · A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Constructor starts fire-and-forget connect; failures mark offline/recovering and a five-second timer eventually returns healthy.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；保留后果：Preserve automatic reconnect and offline visibility.；迁移后果：Split startup test into layer acquisition, health stream, and journal recovery.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1103-1147。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1103-1147](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L1103-L1147) |

| <a id="map-58be22469e"></a>[MAP-58BE22469E](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ACCOUNT-LIFECYCLE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-account-lifecycle) · A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 保留 | 旧字段/行为：Constructor begins a nonblocking connection; _callBroker races a grace timer and returns CONNECTING while background init continues, without incrementing failures.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；保留后果：Preserve 1.5s bounded cold-start read and non-poisoning behavior.；迁移后果：Use TestClock only around scoped connection service.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1526-1577。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts:1526-1577](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts#L1526-L1577) |
| <a id="map-dc4d7b4995"></a>[MAP-DC4D7B4995](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ACCOUNT-LIFECYCLE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-account-lifecycle) · A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：The module imports native SDK values, mutable Git persistence, runtime guard construction, and accounting/history helpers directly into UnifiedTradingAccount.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；保留后果：Preserve broker-specific field support and existing history projection shapes at the public facade.；迁移后果：Create domain/action and broker-spi ports first.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1-37。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1-37](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L1-L37) |
| <a id="map-2965b55af1"></a>[MAP-2965B55AF1](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ACCOUNT-LIFECYCLE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-account-lifecycle) · A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Constructor behavior is selected by a loose options object and callbacks; savedState is a GitExportState and guard options are Record&lt;string,unknown&gt;.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；保留后果：Preserve asVendor as discovery participation and keyless/read-only user intent.；迁移后果：Replace options with versioned decoder and explicit service dependencies.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:41-55。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:41-55](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L41-L55) |
| <a id="map-760aaf71fb"></a>[MAP-760AAF71FB](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：The UTA accepts loose protocol parameter bags and later converts them to native Order/Decimal objects.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve string precision and all supported entry semantics including notional and trailing forms.；迁移后果：Define codecs/constructors and migrate application callers.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:59-78。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:59-78](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L59-L78) |

| <a id="map-7af82c011b"></a>[MAP-7AF82C011B](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-SCOPE-ROUTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-scope-routing) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Identity is a delimiter string with no validation for empty account/native components and is generated by a domain object from broker SDK data.；本节具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。；保留后果：Preserve stable account/instrument lookup behavior and adapter-specific native key hints.；迁移后果：Introduce branded codecs and migrate all aliceId consumers.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede 任何 live alias/default route 解释：LegacyUtaIdAlias 仅作已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping；DispatchStarted 后不得 reprepare。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:509-520。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:509-520](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L509-L520) |
| <a id="map-6227b2afb6"></a>[MAP-6227B2AFB6](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-SCOPE-ROUTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-scope-routing) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：A UTA method resolves external string identity directly to a concrete SDK Contract and throws generic errors for malformed/cross-account input.；本节具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。；保留后果：Preserve loud refusal for malformed and cross-account input.；迁移后果：Migrate quote/staging/catalog callers to InstrumentResolver.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede 任何 live alias/default route 解释：LegacyUtaIdAlias 仅作已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping；DispatchStarted 后不得 reprepare。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:522-545。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:522-545](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L522-L545) |
| <a id="map-520cfd3057"></a>[MAP-520CFD3057](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Funded readOnly can stage/commit local proposals, while keyless cannot stage and neither can mutate external account.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve exact keyless stage refusal and funded readOnly local stage/commit.；迁移后果：Split UTA stage compatibility from transaction prepare/approve services.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:549-563。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:549-563](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L549-L563) |
| <a id="map-d615cba78e"></a>[MAP-D615CBA78E](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Safety check uses a fresh live read but no persisted exposure snapshot/version; full close bypasses quantity check.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve reduce-only oversized protection and full-close behavior.；迁移后果：Move current position read into Prepare and recheck before DispatchStarted.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:565-595。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:565-595](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L565-L595) |

| <a id="map-7864431508"></a>[MAP-7864431508](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Staging immediately constructs a mutable SDK Contract/Order and writes an unversioned Git staging operation; all optional order relations are retained only as SDK fields/nested tpsl.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve every accepted field: notional, trailing limit/initial stop, GTD, outside session, parent/OCA, TP/SL, side/order kind.；迁移后果：Migrate stage callers to CreateDraft.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:693-725。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:693-725](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L693-L725) |
| <a id="map-100c8043f8"></a>[MAP-100C8043F8](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：A caller can stage a partial patch without observing current order/version or knowing whether a field means retain/clear.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve supported quantity/price/type/tif/GTD modifications.；迁移后果：Add FieldPatch schema distinguishing retain vs clear.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:727-740。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:727-740](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L727-L740) |
| <a id="map-603c98b3c5"></a>[MAP-603C98B3C5](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Close intent stores SDK Contract and optional Decimal in Git; full-close meaning is an undefined field.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve positive partial/full-close semantics and subaccount validation.；迁移后果：Migrate stageClose callers to transaction commands.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:742-767。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:742-767](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L742-L767) |
| <a id="map-a0c78d8c68"></a>[MAP-A0C78D8C68](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Cancel is admitted to mutable staging without scope/order snapshot/version or capability evidence.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；保留后果：Preserve ability to cancel by order id.；迁移后果：Replace git.add with CreateDraft.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:769-772。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:769-772](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L769-L772) |
| <a id="map-dbbd7be69c"></a>[MAP-DBBD7BE69C](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/CoreAccount/analyses.json) | [LCORE-JOURNAL-OUTBOX](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-journal-outbox) · A2, A3, A5, A6, A7, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Git hash is treated as prepared token and subaccount tracker is cleared only after Git commit.；本节具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。；保留后果：Preserve empty-staging refusal and reviewable commit summary.；迁移后果：Map legacy commit to Prepare.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede replayable permission、Git-as-execution 和 DispatchStarted 后 reprepare；持久化的是 authorization/plan evidence，只有 fresh Start 给一次性 process-bound DispatchGrant，duplicate/query Start 只有 AlreadyStarted。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:776-781。 明确取舍：旧 marker 缺失不证明 NoStart；仅 positive no-callback provenance 可退休，缺 native/attempt identity 的 legacy post-push 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才能历史 resolve。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:776-781](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L776-L781) |

Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。；保留后果：Preserve log/show/status public readability during migration.；迁移后果：Add projection-store query APIs and compatibility mapping.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede replayable permission、Git-as-execution 和 DispatchStarted 后 reprepare；持久化的是 authorization/plan evidence，只有 fresh Start 给一次性 process-bound DispatchGrant，duplicate/query Start 只有 AlreadyStarted。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:815-825。 明确取舍：旧 marker 缺失不证明 NoStart；仅 positive no-callback provenance 可退休，缺 native/attempt identity 的 legacy post-push 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才能历史 resolve。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:815-825](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L815-L825) |

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-177DF827E5 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A8**

> MockBroker idempotency/absence evidence must be supplied by its interpreter contract; otherwise the crash case remains Unknown and requires reconciliation.

旧字段/行为：Every test enters through the real UTA constructor and treats TradingGit staging plus SDK Operation as the observable seam.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；问题处置：该边界由当前 host contract 固定；旧问题的实际字段仍按本节 schema/effect/authority 关系迁移。；保留后果：Retain the vertical intent of constructing a real account around a mock interpreter.；迁移后果：Replace createUTA with a harness that opens a file-backed SQLite/journal fixture and an explicit MockBroker layer; reopen the same fixture for crash/restart scenarios.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。。

**MAP-7F92A5F120 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A8**

> Which external identity provider fields form Actor and policy version is owned by the application group; this shard cannot infer it from UTA options.

旧字段/行为：Funded read-only accounts can stage and commit a local proposal; push and a direct TradingGit push both refuse mutation, while keyless implies readOnly and refuses proposal staging.；本节具体目标关系（账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测）：把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。；问题处置：该边界由当前 host contract 固定；旧问题的实际字段仍按本节 schema/effect/authority 关系迁移。；保留后果：Preserve asVendor participation as a discovery concern, not as trade authorization.；迁移后果：Replace flag assertions with command/approval tests carrying explicit Actor and AccountScope.；明确取舍：本次选择明确：health/connection observation 不授予当前 permission witness，也不把旧 flag 当作 Actor 或 authorization。。

**MAP-4144027899 · 由主机契约决定 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A8**

> Whether sub-account discovery is static per connection or can change at runtime must be declared by each broker adapter; the current cache comment assumes static.

旧字段/行为：Single implicit broker stages without a selector; a warmed multi-wallet broker refuses missing/unknown/wrong selectors and appends [sub:spot] to a commit message, then clears the tracker between cycles.；本节具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。；问题处置：该边界由当前 host contract 固定；旧问题的实际字段仍按本节 schema/effect/authority 关系迁移。；保留后果：Retain caller convenience when discovery proves exactly one wallet by resolving it to an explicit sub-account id; preserve instrument-consistency refusal and cycle isolation.；迁移后果：Persist SubAccountRef discovery with connection identity and freshness.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede 任何 live alias/default route 解释：LegacyUtaIdAlias 仅作已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping；DispatchStarted 后不得 reprepare。。

**MAP-189E766E12 · 由主机契约决定 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8**

> Native idempotency support of MockBroker is test-owned; absent evidence should keep Unknown unresolved.

旧字段/行为：Place-order tests spy on direct broker.placeOrder, inspect forwarded SDK fields, treat submitted status as success, and only check rejected length for an error result.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；问题处置：该边界由当前 host contract 固定；旧问题的实际字段仍按本节 schema/effect/authority 关系迁移。；保留后果：Preserve all order fields that adapters actually support, including precision and contract identity.；迁移后果：Create a MockBroker interpreter that returns explicit Ack and later OrderSnapshot.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。。

**MAP-F5D4E6C3D4 · 由主机契约决定 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8**

> Whether each broker exposes a monotonic exposure version is unresolved; otherwise hash canonical observed facts and treat absence as weaker precondition.

旧字段/行为：Legacy dispatch reads current positions immediately before close, compares absolute quantity, and uses undefined quantity as full close.；本节具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。；问题处置：该边界由当前 host contract 固定；旧问题的实际字段仍按本节 schema/effect/authority 关系迁移。；保留后果：Preserve positive partial/full-close semantics and the no-oversize safety check.；迁移后果：Make quantity decoder and exposure comparison pure; persist snapshot and conflict key.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede global action-map、mutable SDK Order 与隐含默认组合；provider leaf 只声明其 exact alternatives，受控效果遵循发送后 Unknown。。

**MAP-7A53419830 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8**

> Broker-specific cancellation idempotency horizon remains adapter evidence, not inferred from method name.

> 原调查：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1108-1114: the reconcile helper exists only because GitCommit requires stateAfter and intentionally avoids recursive broker reads; replacing Git requires an event payload that carries real observed facts rather than reintroducing recursive query writes.

**当前承接：** [LCORE-JOURNAL-OUTBOX](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-journal-outbox)。旧事实保留：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1108-1114: the reconcile helper exists only because GitCommit requires stateAfter and intentionally avoids recursive broker reads; replacing Git requires an event payload that carries real observed facts rather than reintroducing recursive query writes.；具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。 旧 Git 行的 legacy import 必须遵守上述 NoStartRetirement/LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing 规则，而不是从 marker 缺失推断未发送。。

> 原调查：Composition finding: the fixed descriptor envelope is the only UTA-facing common surface. Provider-specific trees, schemas, errors, native fields and handlers remain adapter-owned; the historical UTA IBroker switch is not a target contract.

**当前承接：** [LCORE-CROSS-BOUNDARY](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-cross-boundary)。旧事实保留：Composition finding: the fixed descriptor envelope is the only UTA-facing common surface. Provider-specific trees, schemas, errors, native fields and handlers remain adapter-owned; the historical UTA IBroker switch is not a target contract.；具体目标关系（跨组不变量与证据边界）：本章所有迁移都服从 A1–A8：一个 schema-bound capability definition 绑定 semantic unit、exact slots、requirements、delivery 与 controlled-effect protocol；provider vocabulary open、kernel control ADT finite；Effect service、permission witness、availability/evidence 和 historical interpretation resolver 分离。动态 descriptor 必须 construction-bound，stream item-error/snapshot-end 与 terminal sum 分离，deferred invocation 用 durable pure checkpoint 与 single activation owner。 Coverage 对外固定为 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，未知仅是 value/quality/reason；公共 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 而不被强制 journalize。迁移仅采用离线 parity/import 后的单一 authority cutover，不做 speculative dual-read/shim。 受控效果必须保持 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的 recipe/receipt/stage-error 关联与 admission/execution R/P 分离；只有 fresh Start 返回 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只能返回 AlreadyStarted。No-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable policy 必须预先选择 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，并在同一 control CAS 下处理 timeout/response，永不 auto-exec fallback。普通 live data 可以用 asOf/coverage 读取并保留 provenance，不必把所有事实写进 journal。 旧 Git import 同样不以 DispatchStarted marker 缺失推定 NoStart：只有正面的 no-callback provenance 才可退休；缺 native/attempt identity 的旧 post-push 为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才可历史 resolve。。

If CoreAccount later participates in a trigger binding, activation must carry frozen intent/revision, scope and policy evidence and pass the normal execution authorization path.；具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。 旧 Git 行的 legacy import 必须遵守上述 NoStartRetirement/LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing 规则，而不是从 marker 缺失推断未发送。。

**当前承接：** [LCORE-CROSS-BOUNDARY](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-cross-boundary)。旧事实保留：K11: Existing source facts, durability boundaries, unknown/precision/absence obligations and open native questions remain evidence. Reframing removes obsolete universal-SDK conclusions without declaring sibling ownership or empirical gaps solved.；具体目标关系（跨组不变量与证据边界）：本章所有迁移都服从 A1–A8：一个 schema-bound capability definition 绑定 semantic unit、exact slots、requirements、delivery 与 controlled-effect protocol；provider vocabulary open、kernel control ADT finite；Effect service、permission witness、availability/evidence 和 historical interpretation resolver 分离。动态 descriptor 必须 construction-bound，stream item-error/snapshot-end 与 terminal sum 分离，deferred invocation 用 durable pure checkpoint 与 single activation owner。 Coverage 对外固定为 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，未知仅是 value/quality/reason；公共 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 而不被强制 journalize。迁移仅采用离线 parity/import 后的单一 authority cutover，不做 speculative dual-read/shim。 受控效果必须保持 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的 recipe/receipt/stage-error 关联与 admission/execution R/P 分离；只有 fresh Start 返回 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只能返回 AlreadyStarted。No-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable policy 必须预先选择 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，并在同一 control CAS 下处理 timeout/response，永不 auto-exec fallback。普通 live data 可以用 asOf/coverage 读取并保留 provenance，不必把所有事实写进 journal。 旧 Git import 同样不以 DispatchStarted marker 缺失推定 NoStart：只有正面的 no-callback provenance 才可退休；缺 native/attempt identity 的旧 post-push 为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才可历史 resolve。。

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-26E3CBF3C8 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A5, A8**

> 已发布 commit.json 的实际版本集合和迁移入口仍需在实施 slice 中盘点；设计不把其缺失字段补造为已确认远端事实。

Old source behavior/question: 旧事实/疑问：git-persistence.ts 把一个看似领域内的模块同时当作路径选择器、JSON 持久化器和 TradingGit 的回调边界。GitExportState 只是 TypeScript 类型，运行时 JSON 没有 schema 解码，因而文件 IO、序列化形状和执行初始化互相耦合。 证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/git-persistence.ts:1-10,27-40: the old file boundary has no runtime schema/version decoder and treats parse/IO failures as fallback state.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.spec.ts:651-754: visible tests exercise only legacy numeric commit shapes, not shipped-data inventory.；the applicable A-law relation: migration/replay must complete before admission; a guessed fallback cannot authorize execution.. Selected relation (LTX-JOURNAL): JournalStore 的 versioned schema/event codec、AccountScope、sequence/revision、raw provenance 与 exact historical resolver 承接该记录；legacy file 仅作可重建 audit/export，未知或混合历史保留 LegacyEvidence/OperatorRequired/RecoveryRequired，不能成为执行 authority。 Consequence: 在 provider/runtime evidence 到位前保持 empirical Unknown/OperatorRequired，采用该 section 的保守分支，不以默认值补齐。 Closure decision/evidence retained from the restored record: LTX-JOURNAL)：JournalStore 的 versioned schema/event codec、AccountScope、sequence/revision、raw provenance 与 exact historical resolver 承接该记录；legacy file 仅作可重建 audit/export，未知或混合历史保留 LegacyEvidence/OperatorRequired/RecoveryRequired，不能成为执行 authority。 具体后果：在 provider/runtime evidence 到位前保持 empirical Unknown/OperatorRequired，采用该 section 的保守分支，不以默认值补齐。 Closure/evidence retained from the restored record: 版本集合、迁移入口和实际缺失字段仍是 empirical-retained；盘点完成前保留原始 digest/provenance，拒绝执行状态重建并转 OperatorRequired/MigrationRequired. Original investigation evidence: docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/TradingJournal/analyses.json, design.md, entries.md, reviews.json, questions-closure.json (original investigation evidence; byte-identical).

**MAP-BE3B808F2D · 当前源码事实 · A2, A5, A8**

> 现有配置中哪些 broker 的 SingleSubAccount 标识由 adapter 提供仍需在各 adapter capability slice 定义；不能用空字符串充当显式值。

Old source behavior/question: 旧事实/疑问：每个 accountId 有一个独立 commit.json，TradingGit 的整个 completed commit array/head 通过它恢复；文件路径本身因此间接决定了 account 的恢复状态。 证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:56-58,730-748: unified venues use explicit default and contract routing; separate-wallet overrides provide explicit IDs.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/overrides.ts:217-231 and exchanges/bitget.ts:32-42: Binance/Bitget declare spot/derivatives namespaces.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts:1-6 plus the applicable A-law relation: a single relationship/wallet is a domain scope fact, not an empty native selector.；the applicable A-law relation: unresolved directory discovery is ScopeDiscoveryPending.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts:1-6: Leverup funds remain in the user main wallet, so its domain scope is single-wallet rather than a native sub-account string.. Selected relation (LTX-JOURNAL): JournalStore 的 versioned schema/event codec、AccountScope、sequence/revision、raw provenance 与 exact historical resolver 承接该记录；legacy file 仅作可重建 audit/export，未知或混合历史保留 LegacyEvidence/OperatorRequired/RecoveryRequired，不能成为执行 authority。 Consequence: 记录为源码事实；本章不把未给出的实现细节提升为已证实行为。 Closure decision/evidence retained from the restored record: LTX-JOURNAL)：JournalStore 的 versioned schema/event codec、AccountScope、sequence/revision、raw provenance 与 exact historical resolver 承接该记录；legacy file 仅作可重建 audit/export，未知或混合历史保留 LegacyEvidence/OperatorRequired/RecoveryRequired，不能成为执行 authority。 具体后果：记录为源码事实；本章不把未给出的实现细节提升为已证实行为。 Closure/evidence retained from the restored record: 现有 adapter 已能给出 CCXT 的 default/spot/derivatives；Alpaca、Longbridge、Leverup 等单钱包 broker 以显式 SingleSubAccount 表示、IBKR 以 managed account 表示，其他未完成目录发现统一返回 ScopeDiscoveryPending。该 scope 规则只约束账户、订单、持仓和交易效果；公共 Candle/Instrument/News 不凭空附加账户选择器，也不能用空字符串充当显式值. Original investigation evidence: docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/TradingJournal/analyses.json, design.md, entries.md, reviews.json, questions-closure.json (original investigation evidence; byte-identical).

| <a id="map-3ab8de4d1e"></a>[MAP-3AB8DE4D1E](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/ProtocolModels/analyses.json) | [LCORE-PROTOCOL-BROKER-SPI](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-protocol-broker-spi) · A1, A2, A3, A4, A8 | 保留 | 旧字段/行为：Sub-account listing and instrument routing are optional methods; UTA special-cases absent methods as implicit default and validates requested IDs only for discovered multi-wallet accounts.；本节具体目标关系（IBroker 兼容面的拆分与 scoped provider port）：固定 UTA-facing `CapabilityDescriptor` envelope（identity/path、schema version/fingerprint、exact slots、delivery/effect/resource/provenance/availability），provider capability tree 保持开放。每个 leaf 自己声明 `Input/Success/Failure/Delivery`，仅需要账户事实或受控效果的 leaf 才绑定 AccountScope；查询、流、Layer/resource 和 private native interpreter 分离。；保留后果：Preserve convenience for single-wallet brokers only after scoped `Available` discovery proves one wallet; construct explicit `default` from that result, while unavailable/ambiguous/unauthorized discovery returns the exact typed result and never fabricates a route.；迁移后果：Migrate scope resolver and all write/read callers.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede generic IBroker/full SDK facade；provider tree open，Effect service 与 permission witness 分离。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts:531-551。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts:531-551](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts#L531-L551)；[packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts:256-305](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts#L256-L305) |

| <a id="map-a27d9fadf9"></a>[MAP-A27D9FADF9](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/ProtocolModels/analyses.json) | [LCORE-PROTOCOL-BROKER-SPI](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-protocol-broker-spi) · A1, A2, A3, A4, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：The global side effect makes every imported Contract appear to carry Alice identity, and UTA mutates broker-returned contracts before persistence/projection.；本节具体目标关系（IBroker 兼容面的拆分与 scoped provider port）：固定 UTA-facing `CapabilityDescriptor` envelope（identity/path、schema version/fingerprint、exact slots、delivery/effect/resource/provenance/availability），provider capability tree 保持开放。每个 leaf 自己声明 `Input/Success/Failure/Delivery`，仅需要账户事实或受控效果的 leaf 才绑定 AccountScope；查询、流、Layer/resource 和 private native interpreter 分离。；保留后果：Preserve each broker’s documented native uniqueness primitive and downstream resolution behavior when proven.；迁移后果：Migrate all `contract-ext` imports and `contract.aliceId` consumers to InstrumentId codecs.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede generic IBroker/full SDK facade；provider tree open，Effect service 与 permission witness 分离。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/types/contract-ext.ts:1-31。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/types/contract-ext.ts:1-31](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/contract-ext.ts#L1-L31)；[services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:1026-1029](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts#L1026-L1029) |
| <a id="map-430a3ccb4d"></a>[MAP-430A3CCB4D](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/ProtocolModels/analyses.json) | [LCORE-PROTOCOL-ERROR-FAILURE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-protocol-error-failure) · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Every endpoint is expected to return one loose error bag, while the client turns any body into a generic Error-like UTAHttpError; route/action context is not preserved.；本节具体目标关系（协议错误、未知结果与边界解码）：在 boundary decode unknown→exact `Failure` ADT，并按 capability identity/path、provider instance、request/attempt、schema revision/digest 关联。Load/input/domain/output/transport/authorization/provider rejection/storage/DispatchUnknown 各自保留；expected native rejection、pending observation 与 unknown 不相等。permission witness 与 Effect service 不能由错误分类伪造。；保留后果：Preserve human-readable hint/message as redacted presentation text.；迁移后果：Define schemas in `protocol/` and map all transaction/query/capability routes.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede universal Error.message/WireBrokerError 语义；failure、Unknown 与 stream terminal 均按 exact slot 解码。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/types/errors.ts:1-19。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/types/errors.ts:1-19](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/errors.ts#L1-L19)；[packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:75-84](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts#L75-L84) |
| <a id="map-d32aed6801"></a>[MAP-D32AED6801](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/ProtocolModels/analyses.json) | [LCORE-PROTOCOL-JOURNAL-STATE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-protocol-journal-state) · A2, A3, A5, A6, A7, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：Trading-as-Git protocol records currently use SDK instances and runtime Decimal as their staged and persisted operation representation; TradingGit later projects some Order fields but retains native types in the declared model.；本节具体目标关系（Git/事务状态的公共投影）：只把 schema-encoded durable plan/receipt/projection 暴露到 public boundary。核心控制 ADT 穷尽处理 Draft/Prepared/Approved/DispatchStarted/Ack/Observation/Unknown/Recovery/terminal；provider order alternatives 仍是开放 leaf schema。Simulation input/result 是 simulator-specific public projection，不借此定义金融交易通用动作。 受控结果遵循 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的关联：admission 与 execution 的 R/P 不混淆；fresh Start 才发 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只有 `AlreadyStarted`，持久化 authorization 不是 grant。 受控 definition/command/plan 使用 RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 的完整、分域、版本化 digest；该算法规则属于 host contract，不由短 hash 或 displayed JSON key sorting 代替。；保留后果：Preserve audit narrative, Decimal precision, external-order and reconcile facts.；迁移后果：Create normalized protocol modules and migrate `git/TradingGit.ts` through an application adapter.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede short hash as authority、replayable grant 与 post-start reprepare；Controlled 关联 receipt/control-result/stage-error，Start grant 一次性消费。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts:1-11。 明确取舍：旧 marker 缺失不证明 NoStart；仅 positive no-callback provenance 可退休，缺 native/attempt identity 的 legacy post-push 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才能历史 resolve。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts:1-11](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts#L1-L11)；[services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:8-31](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts#L8-L31) |
| <a id="map-89e53c0637"></a>[MAP-89E53C0637](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/ProtocolModels/analyses.json) | [LCORE-PROTOCOL-JOURNAL-STATE](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-protocol-journal-state) · A2, A3, A5, A6, A7, A8 | 保留 | 旧字段/行为：Hashes are generated from JSON.stringify field order and represented by plain strings; collision, canonical encoding, hash algorithm, and full journal sequence are not encoded.；本节具体目标关系（Git/事务状态的公共投影）：只把 schema-encoded durable plan/receipt/projection 暴露到 public boundary。核心控制 ADT 穷尽处理 Draft/Prepared/Approved/DispatchStarted/Ack/Observation/Unknown/Recovery/terminal；provider order alternatives 仍是开放 leaf schema。Simulation input/result 是 simulator-specific public projection，不借此定义金融交易通用动作。 受控结果遵循 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的关联：admission 与 execution 的 R/P 不混淆；fresh Start 才发 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只有 `AlreadyStarted`，持久化 authorization 不是 grant。 受控 definition/command/plan 使用 RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 的完整、分域、版本化 digest；该算法规则属于 host contract，不由短 hash 或 displayed JSON key sorting 代替。；保留后果：Preserve human-facing short hash display and parent-chain navigation when evidence supports it.；迁移后果：Add branded IDs and canonical encoding version.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede short hash as authority、replayable grant 与 post-start reprepare；Controlled 关联 receipt/control-result/stage-error，Start grant 一次性消费。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts:13-16。 明确取舍：旧 marker 缺失不证明 NoStart；仅 positive no-callback provenance 可退休，缺 native/attempt identity 的 legacy post-push 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才能历史 resolve。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts:13-16](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts#L13-L16)；[services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:38-43](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts#L38-L43) |

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-9F0ED3057E · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> Native SDK/provider error fields, stable code precedence, and idempotency/absence guarantees are unavailable in this shared source; each adapter must supply evidence before classifying a native failure as safe retry or terminal rejection.

旧字段/行为：`classifyMessage` lowercases arbitrary text and applies the observed precedence (market-closed, network/timeouts/rate limits/5xx, AUTH, forbidden/funds/margin), then returns a legacy code or null; no native provider error schema or idempotency evidence is present in this shared module.；本节具体目标关系（协议错误、未知结果与边界解码）：在 boundary decode unknown→exact `Failure` ADT，并按 capability identity/path、provider instance、request/attempt、schema revision/digest 关联。Load/input/domain/output/transport/authorization/provider rejection/storage/DispatchUnknown 各自保留；expected native rejection、pending observation 与 unknown 不相等。permission witness 与 Effect service 不能由错误分类伪造。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Preserve the observed regex precedence and redacted lexical evidence as adapter-local diagnostics during migration; it is not a native guarantee.；迁移后果：Move the regex table into each adapter as a last-resort classifier that emits HeuristicEvidence, with explicit redaction and classifier version.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede universal Error.message/WireBrokerError 语义；failure、Unknown 与 stream terminal 均按 exact slot 解码。。


### 跨组契约与补充发现

> 原调查：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:603-637 validates MKT Units versus cashQty Notional, requires prices by order type, and distinguishes TRAIL from TRAIL LIMIT with mutually exclusive auxPrice/trailingPercent; any provider-declared order leaf must preserve these relations before native compilation; the allowed sizing/kind combinations remain provider-specific.

**当前承接：** [LCORE-ORDER-INTENT](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-order-intent)。旧事实保留：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:603-637 validates MKT Units versus cashQty Notional, requires prices by order type, and distinguishes TRAIL from TRAIL LIMIT with mutually exclusive auxPrice/trailingPercent; any provider-declared order leaf must preserve these relations before native compilation; the allowed sizing/kind combinations remain provider-specific.；具体目标关系（订单意图、精确单位与 provider 扩展）：订单是 semantic Unit&lt;Schema&gt;，不是 mutable IBKR Order，也不是全局 Cartesian action map。每个 provider leaf 用同一 construction-bound declaration 绑定精确 input/success/failure/delivery；基础意图组合 target、side、size/price/time/relationship，provider extension 保留 notional/quantity、parent/OCA、native protection、session、MOC/LOC/REL/OPG 等真实字段及合法组合。动态调用必须用 capability certificate 的同一 schema slot 解码，不能以同形 JSON 互换。。

> 原调查：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:642-688 memoizes broker subaccounts, treats an absent/empty listing (including not-yet-probed) as one implicit default, and only then validates requested wallet against instrument routing; directory discovery must instead expose Discovering/Available/Unavailable and never infer execution scope.

**当前承接：** [LCORE-SCOPE-ROUTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-scope-routing)。旧事实保留：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:642-688 memoizes broker subaccounts, treats an absent/empty listing (including not-yet-probed) as one implicit default, and only then validates requested wallet against instrument routing; directory discovery must instead expose Discovering/Available/Unavailable and never infer execution scope.；具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。。

> 原调查：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:776-790 clears staged subaccount IDs after commit and persists them only by appending a [sub:...] message tag; operation/action payloads and durable conflict keys therefore need an explicit AccountScope migration rather than message parsing.

**当前承接：** [LCORE-SCOPE-ROUTING](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-scope-routing)。旧事实保留：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:776-790 clears staged subaccount IDs after commit and persists them only by appending a [sub:...] message tag; operation/action payloads and durable conflict keys therefore need an explicit AccountScope migration rather than message parsing.；具体目标关系（账户身份、子账户目录与作用域路由）：使用彼此不可替代的 Public、AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId 与 LegacyUtaIdAlias。作用域目录是 revisioned ADT（Discovering/Available/Unavailable），每个 capability leaf 声明所需 scope；公共数据不伪造 account/subaccount，账户事实和受控效果必须带明确 AccountScope。动态证书绑定 provider instance、capability identity、declaration revision、full semantic/schema digest 及 schema slot。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias`/`IdentityBinding` 只用于对已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，绝不成为运行时 live alias、dual-read 或 compatibility shim。。

> 原调查：services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:141-185 executes each operation and only afterward snapshots state, appends/persists GitCommit, and clears staging; a remote side effect can precede persistence failure, so the controlled-effect wrapper must write DispatchStarted and attempt identity before adapter mutation and classify response loss as Unknown.

**当前承接：** [LCORE-JOURNAL-OUTBOX](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-journal-outbox)。旧事实保留：services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts:141-185 executes each operation and only afterward snapshots state, appends/persists GitCommit, and clears staging; a remote side effect can precede persistence failure, so the controlled-effect wrapper must write DispatchStarted and attempt identity before adapter mutation and classify response loss as Unknown.；具体目标关系（Git 操作、受控效果与持久发送边界）：把旧 Git 外观解释为受控效果的投影：纯 Decision/Evolution 生成 immutable prepared plan；single writer 在 admission 时检查 command identity、版本、scope、policy 与 reservation，先提交 DispatchStarted/outbox/attempt，再交给 provider interpreter。Ack、working、fill、rejection、observation 和 compensation 是不同 evidence；same command+same encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，冲突输入拒绝。 完整关系是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>`：recipe 始终关联 receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema；admission 所需 services/permissions 与已安装解释器的 execution R/P 分开。只有 fresh successful Start transition 产生一次性、process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence 且绝不返回可重放 grant，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 也不是 grant。 Definition、command 与 plan digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整 digest 与版本化 domain separation；重复 JSON key、非有限数和非法 Unicode 在边界拒绝，decimal-string/array 顺序按声明语义编码。本章不把窄 specimen 当作该算法已实现的证明。 旧 Git 行的 legacy import 必须遵守上述 NoStartRetirement/LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing 规则，而不是从 marker 缺失推断未发送。。
