### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-139EBB287C · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4**

> Exact authentication header/credential reference and correlation header names are not present in this source; Main must choose them at the protocol boundary.

旧事实：The package documents a generic HTTP helper and promises only Error-shaped failures; endpoint-specific codecs and typed downstream errors are explicitly future work.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/integration-decisions.md:C09 plus packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:1-11: the current helper has no auth/correlation context, while C09 fixes Authorization: Bearer &lt;resolved credential&gt;, X-Request-ID, local opaque CredentialRef, and no wire TransportPrincipal.。当前 host decision：C09 resolves the Alice HTTP naming and authority shape: use Authorization: Bearer &lt;resolved credential&gt; and X-Request-ID with response echo; CredentialRef is local opaque and resolved through UTA-owned ServiceCredentialBinding, never sent as a wire field. No wire TransportPrincipal, actor claim, loopback assertion, or secret enters capability input/diagnostics. Credential provisioning, revocation, and verifier behavior remain implementation-gate evidence, not unresolved header or credential naming.

**MAP-A4FE5AF865 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4**

> The wire representation of TransportPrincipal and the auth mechanism is not specified in the current files.

旧事实：Client construction normalizes only URL/fetch/timeout configuration; it has no transport principal, correlation context, or separate actor/policy/capability authorization input.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/integration-decisions.md:C09 plus packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:13-20: C09 fixes service-credential binding and rejects a wire TransportPrincipal; the source options only contain baseUrl/fetch/timeout.。当前 host decision：C09 resolves the wire question: Alice uses the fixed service-credential profile and UTA constructs/checks authenticated service identity from ServiceCredentialBinding; TransportPrincipal is not a caller or wire record. Actor, policy, scope, and capability authority remain separate. Provisioning, rotation/revocation, and deployment verifier behavior are runtime acceptance gates, not alternate auth-shape choices.

**MAP-A458F81B6D · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4**

> Exact final route list is a shared Main/protocol decision; current architecture lists ten transaction routes but not every query projection name.

旧事实：Any caller can supply any HTTP verb/path/body and obtain a compile-time cast to T; the interface does not enumerate public routes or distinguish command from query responses.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：Audit commit a5f23756531cc552b7e12b6d655ae1ffbcd28b64 records the previous ten-route proposal; current UTAClient.ts:22-29 exposes arbitrary verbs and paths. Composition-contract.md K01/K02/K06 instead fixes descriptor metadata and generated interpretation, leaving provider capability trees and leaf schemas open.。当前 host decision：The old ten-route list is retained only as historical source evidence, not as the target route contract. The target exposes capability discovery and descriptor-bound invocation: each provider declares its own query, stream, admin, or controlled-effect tree, and generated named methods/help come from those declarations. There is no public raw dispatch method and no global ActionContractMap. Implementers must still prove identity/fingerprint binding and structural absence for a provider tree.

**MAP-06118417F5 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4, A6**

> Whether cancellation is represented as TransportCancelled or a shared interruption variant is not established in the current protocol.

旧事实：RequestOpts accepts arbitrary JSON and stringifies every query value; AbortSignal is the only structured control input.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/integration-decisions.md:C11 plus packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:31-35: the source exposes only AbortSignal, while C11 fixes the public Promise/AbortSignal shape, AsyncIterable push, and local cancellation/deadline variants.。当前 host decision：C11 resolves cancellation representation: public Alice HTTP is Promise&lt;Result&lt;Output, Failure&gt;&gt; plus AbortSignal; local cancellation/deadline failures are Cancelled and DeadlineExceeded, transport loss is TransportUnavailable, and malformed envelopes are ProtocolViolation. Push cancellation is a resource-scoped AsyncIterable control/close, not a universal provider error. A controlled effect interrupted after its durable send boundary remains Unknown/recovery and is reconciled by UTA observation. Runtime cancellation/deadline and stream-close conformance remains an implementation acceptance gate.

**MAP-7E1806AFC4 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4**

> The exact failure tag names in the shared package are not yet implemented; they must align with Main’s transaction/query failure ADTs.

旧事实：Non-2xx responses become a JavaScript Error subclass; callers can inspect status/body but cannot exhaustively distinguish validation, auth, conflict, storage, or broker outcomes.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/integration-decisions.md:C11 plus packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:37-46: the source only stores status/body/message, while C11 fixes local boundary variants and remote error wrappers.。当前 host decision：C11 resolves the shared failure tags without imposing a provider taxonomy: local transport failures are Cancelled, DeadlineExceeded, TransportUnavailable, and ProtocolViolation; verified remote boundary failures use RemoteBoundaryFailure with named code; verified leaf domain failures use RemoteDomainFailure&lt;LeafError&gt;. Leaf error schemas remain provider-declared, and possible-send outcome remains UTA dispatch/recovery evidence rather than an HTTP rejection tag. Runtime envelope decoding and native outcome evidence remain implementation acceptance gates.

**MAP-22C9C06082 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4**

> Auth/correlation header names remain a shared protocol decision.

旧事实：The helper correctly normalizes a base URL and supports injected/global fetch, but URL construction is open-ended and silently stringifies unvalidated values.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/integration-decisions.md:C09 plus packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:48-61: the source accepts arbitrary paths and String-converted queries and emits no auth/correlation headers; C09 fixes the private header profile.。当前 host decision：C09 resolves the header names: descriptor-bound Alice HTTP emits Authorization: Bearer &lt;resolved credential&gt; and X-Request-ID, with response correlation echo. CredentialRef, secret bytes, and TransportPrincipal stay out of URL/query/body and logs; descriptor schemas encode path/query values and reject malformed input before fetch. Native provider paths remain open behind descriptor identity, not a fixed historical route list. Header emission/echo, redaction, and prefetch validation remain runtime acceptance checks.

**MAP-8C22894ED4 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4, A6**

> Whether the HTTP client should return Effect directly or a Promise wrapper interpreted by transport/http is a Main-owned module-shape decision.

旧事实：The implementation performs real HTTP and clears its timer, but successful bodies are unchecked and non-2xx errors are reduced to a string field; caller abort signals replace the internally timed signal.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/integration-decisions.md:C11 plus packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:63-88: the source is Promise-based with unchecked JSON and replacement of its deadline signal by caller AbortSignal; C11 fixes the public shape and composition rule.。当前 host decision：C11 resolves the module shape: public Alice HTTP returns Promise&lt;Result&lt;Output, Failure&gt;&gt; and accepts AbortSignal; push uses AsyncIterable frames. Effect may be used internally but is not an SDK or foreign-provider dependency. Caller cancellation and internal deadline are composed, schemas decode before application use, and response loss after a durable effect boundary remains Unknown/recovery rather than wrapper-driven retry or rejection. Runtime conformance is an implementation acceptance gate, not an unresolved architecture choice.

**MAP-E56045946F · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4**

> Redaction limits and exact evidence fields require coordination with observability design.

旧事实：Malformed response text is deliberately returned as an unknown value, allowing error handling to proceed with a string body.。当前章节关系：construction-bound Definition/CertifiedDocument 将 schema slot、provider/revision/digest、auth/correlation 与 boundary failure 绑定；Effect service R 与 runtime permission P 分离。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/integration-decisions.md:C11 plus packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts:101-103: the source returns raw text after JSON parse failure, while C11 fixes bounded metadata-only ProtocolViolation evidence and forbids raw-body digest.。当前 host decision：C11 resolves the evidence shape and limits: retain only request/capability/schema identity, phase, HTTP status, content type, received byte count, and at most 16 named issue codes/schema paths (path &lt;=128 characters; whole UTF-8 JSON &lt;=4096 bytes; truncation marked). Never retain response body, parameters, headers, native message, or raw-body digest; malformed output is ProtocolViolation and cannot become a domain value. Schema validation and actual sink enforcement remain implementation-gate checks, not unresolved field/limit design.

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-0682C42EA8 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A6**

> 仍需在各 broker adapter 核实 native sentinel 的完整集合与版本；Mock/IBKR 当前证据只覆盖此测试使用的几种。

旧事实：Mocks a raw OpenOrder with IBKR UNSET numeric values and zero parentId, then verifies that unset optional fields are omitted from the returned order summary.。当前章节关系：generated HTTP query/stream interpreter 依赖 final descriptor leaf，wire schema、scope、coverage 与 typed boundary failure 同步验证。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：services/uta/src/__tests__/trading-tools.spec.ts:169-193 only exercises UNSET price fields and parentId=0 in a mocked OpenOrder; packages/ibkr/src/const.ts:10-13 defines UNSET_INTEGER, UNSET_DOUBLE, UNSET_LONG, and UNSET_DECIMAL, while packages/ibkr/src/order.ts:47-75,180-225,240-244 applies sentinel/default values across many native fields. services/uta/src/domain/trading/OrderHelper.ts:35-44,68-100 lists only seven Decimal fields and performs truthiness-based projection, and AlpacaBroker.ts:287-307, CcxtBroker.ts:519-601, LongbridgeBroker.ts:286-301, and MockBroker.ts:282-348 show adapter-specific UNSET_DECIMAL handling without a documented cross-adapter profile/version matrix. Stable Identity sentinel analysis MAP-60408331F8 and composition requirements K03, K04, K07, and K11 require an adapter-local versioned allowlist and typed fail…。当前 host decision：Retain the empirical prerequisite under capability composition. Each adapter must supply a versioned NativeSentinelProfile plus presence/schema evidence before classifying a native value as Absent for its declared order-observation/effect leaf. Until then, unknown adapter/profile/field/version, missing presence metadata, or ambiguous native defaults yield UnknownNativeSentinel, NativeSentinelSchemaDrift, or PresenceRequired; the observation remains unavailable/unknown, raw values do not enter the selected projection or prepared payload, and no controlled effect is authorized. The confirmed Mock/IBKR fixture still omits its tested UNSET price and parentId=0 fields; other adapters and legitimate zero values remain unclassified until their own evidence exists.

**MAP-2F69B76FDC · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7**

> The repository does not provide the UTA↔Alice service credential/issuer/verifier implementation; Main/deployment must designate the secret provisioning and verifier owner without route-local crypto or a body-supplied identity.

旧事实：Creates an unauthenticated Hono route set and lists ctx.utaManager.listUTAs() directly as the response for GET /uta.。当前章节关系：authenticated generated controlled route 重查 principal/scope/revision/policy/CAS，并保持 Draft/stage-error/receipt 与 frozen no-reply policy。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：src/webui/routes/trading-proxy.ts:4-7 explicitly states that v1 has no Alice↔UTA auth and trusts loopback, while :115-168 forwards the request headers/body unchanged. services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts:127-135 mounts GET /uta without authentication and returns raw manager summaries. Stable cross-group findings MAP-7D7ABA2368 and MAP-139EBB287C plus composition requirements K02, K07, K08, and K09 keep this as a transport/application boundary obligation but do not provide the credential issuer/verifier implementation. No repository implementation establishes the deployment owner or verifier evidence.。当前 host decision：Retain the empirical prerequisite. Deployment/Guardian must provision and identify the UTA↔Alice service credential and verifier before transport admission; this remains a deployment boundary, not a route-local crypto or universal provider contract. Before that boundary is installed, missing/invalid credentials return UnauthenticatedTransport (401), an unprovisioned verifier returns TransportVerifierUnavailable without loopback fallback, and a body-supplied actor is ignored. Only a verified Principal reaches the scope-aware account capability projection, and a selected controlled effect rechecks scope, capability, revision, expiry, policy, and actor binding.

effect leaf。；若已有 shipped boundary 仍要求 legacy projection，只允许离线 parity/import 或只读边界投影；完成后一次切换并删除其 execution authority，index 只暴露 descriptor/configuration/declared Account strings are converted to Decimal then stringified; positions' unrealized_pl is recomputed as aggregate; day trades are converted from a fixed 3-count; failures become BrokerError.from.。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-ALPACA-ACCOUNT`（Alpaca：账户、持仓与账户级事实）规定的具体关系：账户/持仓是 AccountScope-bound data units，不是交易 transaction。`AccountObservation`、`PositionObservation`、`ExecutionObservation` 使用 runtime schema 与 exact decimal strings；side、signed exposure、currency、multiplier、valuation completeness、source/as-of、connection generation 和 observation identity 分开。并发 Pull 的结果保留各自 timestamps/hash 与 consistency marker；`coverage` 仍只报告 `Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable`；未证明 common snapshot 时另附 `ConsistencyEvidence=Unknown\|Inconsistent` payload/reason。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Preserve concurrent account/position fetch and Decimal arithmetic；Preserve broker-supplied market value/PnL as evidence；Intentionally move hardcoded currency/realized semantics into explicit typed decisions；本 section 的具体变更为 为 raw account/position 加 runtime schemas、scope、currency/asset identity、as-of/source 与 row completeness；未知 side/decimal/field 不转换成 short/zero。；将 valuation reducer 作为纯函数：缺失 FX/mark/multiplier/PnL 时返回 Incomplete/DerivedUnavailable，而不是 abs/1/0 fallback。；并发 reads 组合为独立 finite Pull results；不宣称 Promise.all 带来原子快照。；close partial 只消费 Complete scoped exposure observation，并把 before-image/version/hash 复制到 effect plan；账户读取本身不取得交易 lock。；估值 reducer 区分 broker-reported、verified same-currency FX 与 policy-approved Estimated display；未知 FX/mark/multiplier 不用 1 或 0 冒充完整，但已验证的一比一关系可保留。。权属：Account/Position `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：JournalWriter/CAS/command dedupe、reservation、approval、DispatchStarted 和 recovery 由 UTA single writer 管理；Alpaca SDK 只在 private interpretation 内发送。；每个 mutation 叶子独立保留 prepared/ack/observation；组合策略不由一个 global BrokerActionTypeMap 推断。；data pulls（catalog/account/quote）只提供选中 evidence，不被 `withTransaction` 事务化。。切换：按 place→replace→cancel→close 分别生成 provider leaves，先迁移 callers 与 CLI/AI projection，再删除 mutable IBKR action entrypoint。；迁移所有 callers 到 typed receipt/observation；离线 parity/import 仅核对旧输出，随后删除 `PlaceOrderResult`/`OrderState` shape。只有已验证的 published external boundary 仍要求该形状时，才在边界保留只读投影；它绝不具备 execution authority。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/alpaca-contracts.ts:42-65](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/alpaca-contracts.ts#L42-L65) |

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-4C741F2512 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> The installed SDK declarations type order operations as any, so the exact runtime response/error envelope and idempotency behavior still require broker conformance evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：The fixture supplies a partially shaped Alpaca object and lets individual examples replace the broker's private client. Constructor, account, order, clock, and snapshot methods are mocks, while catalog and bar-generator paths are not part of the default layer.。当前 section `LVENUE-ALPACA-CONNECTION` 的具体关系：将连接声明建模为 construction-bound provider definition：non-secret Config 只包含 `ConnectionId`、paper/live intent、label 与 `CredentialRef`/`SecretReference`；`Connection`、SDK client、supervision 和 rate-limit resource 属于 Effect service requirement R。当前 permission witness（principal、AccountScope、policy revision、expiry）是独立的 invocation admission 输入，provide resource 不得制造授权。公开 capability descriptor 只发布已绑定 capability identity、declaration revision、semantic/schema digest 与每个 schema slot 的 certified binding；动态或 foreign 文档不能 cast 成 TS action。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Empirical prerequisite retained: local mocks/declarations do not establish the native order envelope or server idempotency. A typed Alpaca test Layer may validate each declared leaf, but an acknowledgement remains distinct from observation and unknown mutation outcomes use ObserveBeforeRetry; no fixture call count proves durability.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-BDB66E4D30 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> The SDK exposes no health stream or close API; the concrete health probe interval and whether an Alpaca account probe is sufficient for reconnect readiness must be fixed in the executable Slice 4 conformance.

原始问题对应旧行为：init tests instantiate the class with raw credential strings, patch the SDK constructor using any, and observe promise rejection or resolution. Retry timing is tested by replacing global setTimeout, while authentication is identified from an Error message.。当前 section `LVENUE-ALPACA-CONNECTION` 的具体关系：将连接声明建模为 construction-bound provider definition：non-secret Config 只包含 `ConnectionId`、paper/live intent、label 与 `CredentialRef`/`SecretReference`；`Connection`、SDK client、supervision 和 rate-limit resource 属于 Effect service requirement R。当前 permission witness（principal、AccountScope、policy revision、expiry）是独立的 invocation admission 输入，provide resource 不得制造授权。公开 capability descriptor 只发布已绑定 capability identity、declaration revision、semantic/schema digest 与每个 schema slot 的 certified binding；动态或 foreign 文档不能 cast 成 TS action。。本题裁决为 `resolved-by-host-contract`：C06 fixes the supervised connection-probe policy at base 5s, factor 2, max 5m. getAccount proves scoped AccountRead reach only; connection health, catalog/data availability, and global runtime readiness remain separate, and acquisition does not imply mutation admission.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-3372FF782B · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8**

> No local source proves Alpaca server-side client_order_id idempotency, retention horizon, or atomicity of bracket/OTO groups; until live/paper conformance records these, use ObserveBeforeRetry and independent parent/leg reconciliation.

原始问题对应旧行为：Tests call placeOrder directly with mutable IBKR Contract/Order values. ### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-412EC97A15 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A8**

> Whether each venue actually meets the claimed realtime quality is not established by this gated source test; keep stronger quality unavailable until a recorded runtime observation proves it.

旧行为/证据：Each listed exchange is initialized keylessly, its static historicalBars capability is compared to `{supported:true, quality:"realtime"}`, and five public history requests are made. The assertions do not require every close to be positive, do not paginate a second page, and do not persist observations.；本节关系：把 gate、class、mock、barrel 与公共投影放在 provider-pack declaration/support boundary；公共 keyless 读取保持 PublicReadOnly 的有限数据 leaf，不创建 universal IBroker 或 action map。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep the three venue names, five interval requests, limit 50, trailing-window anchoring, ascending timestamps, and freshness bound as acceptance invariants.；Keep the static realtime capability declaration as an unverified adapter claim; do not describe this test as proof of venue finality.；Keep keyless public access.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The three-venue/five-interval shape and freshness assertions remain useful evidence for the declared bar pull, while the host contract and the host contract require a validated row schema and provenance instead of treating the static realtime label as capability proof.；闭环处置：Retain the empirical prerequisite. Until an independent recorded runtime observation binds venue, endpoint, data context (Public for this keyless path, or an explicitly declared account context), instrument, interval, source timestamps, observedAt, and freshness criteria, represent historical quality as HistoricalQuality.Unknown. The compatibility realtime label may remain at the outer public pull descriptor, but it cannot satisfy a stronger quality or finality precondition; preserve bars and stale/malformed evidence without adding order approval, WAL, or account scope by default.；边界证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.e2e.spec.ts:13-51 is gated by CCXT_E2E and exercises keyless public history for binance, okx, and bybit across five intervals, but checks only response shape, ordering, and a freshness bound; it records no independent quality/finality observation. Composition contract K11 separates source/design coverage from runtime proof, and K12 requires a recorded runtime experiment before stronger advertising.

**MAP-DA97124E26 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8**

> Whether every configured Bybit conditional namespace exposes a stable client-order id is not available here; keep broker id plus endpoint/symbol descriptor and no blind idempotent redispatch.

旧行为/证据：The Bybit override performs the four symbol-scoped endpoint attempts and throws only after all fail; CcxtBroker catches that and returns null. convertCcxtOrder maps any returned TP/SL prices into an optional legacy object, so one price yields a partial attachment with no scope/namespace evidence.；本节关系：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled&lt;RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract&gt; leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep Bybit regular/conditional open and closed fallback order.；Keep TP-only, SL-only, both, and no-attachment distinctions.；Keep nullable result only in a legacy display adapter; do not turn endpoint failure into absence.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：Bybit’s four lookup paths and partial TP/SL evidence remain provider-native behavior, while the host contract require a typed namespace leaf and keep client-id idempotency unavailable until independently proven.；闭环处置：Retain the empirical prerequisite. The four lookup paths remain a Bybit-specific order-observation leaf under K07/K08, not a universal SDK contract. Model client-order identity as a namespace-scoped Proven|Unavailable fact. Until each configured conditional path has recorded stable-id and lookup/retention evidence, persist BrokerOrderId with the durable account scope and endpoint/symbol/namespace descriptor, classify identity as Unavailable, and route uncertain recovery to ObserveUnknown/RecoveryRequired; no client-id-based idempotent redispatch is authorized.；边界证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/exchanges/bybit.ts:13-29 and CcxtBroker.spec.ts:339-470 prove the four lookup paths and TP/SL shape cases, but neither source asserts stable client-order ids or their retention across conditional namespaces. Composition contract K07-K08 keep endpoint-specific identity and recovery evidence inside a provider leaf; endpoint presence or mock rows are not client-id proof.

**MAP-23A28BDB57 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A8**

> The e2e source asserts the realtime label but does not establish venue quality/finality; keep stronger quality unavailable until an independent runtime observation is recorded.

旧行为/证据：The adapter advertises account-wide static security/order types and realtime bars even when no catalog, credential, subaccount, endpoint or current runtime health evidence is attached. Search can map FUT/OPT rows, but this capability method does not advertise them.；本节关系：把 quote、bars、funding、orderbook、clock 与 capability observation 作为独立 finite Pull leaf，保留 source/observed time、asOf、精确数值与 Coverage 三值；unknown value/quality 是 payload/reason，普通 live read 不写 full-feed WAL。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep the exact static CRYPTO/CRYPTO_PERP/MKT/LMT shape at the compatibility edge.；Keep historical quality conservative and explicitly unverified by this static test.；Preserve unsupported features as refusals rather than method-presence support.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The static CRYPTO/CRYPTO_PERP and MKT/LMT arrays remain compatibility metadata, while the host contract require instance-scoped capability descriptors and keep historical quality independently evidenced.；闭环处置：Retain the empirical prerequisite. The static arrays and historicalBars label are compatibility metadata in separate capability/data descriptors, not runtime proof or a global action map. Keep historical quality Unknown for the public data leaf. Only an independent recorded observation bound to venue, endpoint, public data context (or an explicitly declared account context), instrument, interval, source timestamps, observedAt, and freshness criteria may produce Proven for the bounded sample; until then, the label cannot authorize stronger historical quality, finality, or any order effect.；边界证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:1290-1296 and CcxtBroker.spec.ts:1679-1688 expose and assert static historicalBars quality=realtime without init, scope, catalog, endpoint, or runtime-quality evidence. Composition contract K11-K12 reject static labels as runtime proof and require independent runtime evidence for native/finality claims.

**MAP-DD87586D0B · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8**

> Native idempotency/clientOrderId guarantees are not established; leave capability unavailable and use durable DispatchIdentity plus observe-only recovery.

旧行为/证据：placeOrder resolves symbol, sizes from totalQuantity or cashQty/reference price, rejects absent sizing, and refuses attached TP/SL unless a venue override exists.；本节关系：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled&lt;RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract&gt; leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep sizing exclusivity/refusal and limit-price preference where valid.；Keep TP/SL override gate and refusal without override; never place unprotected entry silently.；Preserve all supported semantics and refusals.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：Sizing/protection refusal and the absence of native idempotency proof remain important effect evidence, while the host contract compose an optional order leaf and do not mandate a complete provider order handler.；闭环处置：Retain the empirical prerequisite. Native idempotency is an optional, bounded capability of the specific provider effect leaf keyed by venue, endpoint, namespace, account scope, and retention horizon; DispatchIdentity is durable local recovery identity, not native deduplication proof. After DispatchStarted, missing or incomplete proof yields Unknown/RecoveryRequired with ObserveUnknown work, pauses remaining effect steps, and makes no second createOrder call; only recorded evidence within its bound can authorize safe redispatch.；边界证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:509-560 shows sizing, protection gating, and native mutation preparation but no proven native idempotency or clientOrderId contract. Composition contract K08 requires DispatchStarted before createOrder and leaves endpoint-specific idempotency horizons empirical; no provider leaf may infer them from a field or local adapter.

**MAP-D8B89D3086 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8**

> Duplicate-create/clientOrderId behavior is unverified per venue/endpoint; do not enable blind redispatch.

旧行为/证据：The method builds untyped TP/SL/trigger params, maps MKT/LMT/STP/STP LMT, refuses TRAIL/TRAIL LIMIT, calls override/direct createOrder, caches id-to-symbol, and returns legacy result/error text.；本节关系：把 place、modify、cancel、close、sizing、protection、lookup 与 order kind 放入各自 optional Controlled&lt;RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract&gt; leaf；Decision/Evolution 纯编译、writer CAS 后 fresh Start 才给一次性 DispatchGrant，ack/observation/Unknown 独立。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep MKT/LMT/STP/STP LMT mappings, stop trigger semantics, Decimal amount, TP/SL gate, and TRAIL/TRAIL LIMIT refusal until evidence.；Keep venue hooks but type them.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：The direct create path and untyped parameter defect remain source evidence, while the host contract move native parameters into an exact provider extension and keep duplicate-create capability unavailable until proven.；闭环处置：Retain the empirical prerequisite. Duplicate-create behavior is a provider/endpoint-specific capability question, not a requirement of every CCXT leaf. Until a documented, recorded venue/endpoint/account-scope observation establishes duplicate handling and retention, classify idempotency as Unavailable, keep the original DispatchIdentity and lookup descriptor, and recover by observation only rather than issuing a second createOrder.；边界证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:563-626 constructs untyped params, calls an override or default createOrder, caches id-to-symbol, and returns a legacy result; it contains no duplicate-create or clientOrderId guarantee. Composition contract K07-K08 distinguish Ack from observation and prohibit duplicate create after Unknown without provider/endpoint evidence.

**MAP-1FEC8E666F · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A8**

> Whether each venue satisfies realtime historical quality is unavailable from this static/gated test; require recorded source observations before stronger advertising.

旧行为/证据：Capabilities are available pre-init and account-wide; they do not vary by instrument/catalog, wallet scope, sandbox/demo, credential authority or runtime health. The method advertises no TP/SL/trailing/TIF/relation/future/option support.；本节关系：把 quote、bars、funding、orderbook、clock 与 capability observation 作为独立 finite Pull leaf，保留 source/observed time、asOf、精确数值与 Coverage 三值；unknown value/quality 是 payload/reason，普通 live read 不写 full-feed WAL。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 Keep exact static compatibility arrays and historicalBars shape at the edge.；Keep unsupported trailing/options/futures/attachments/relations as explicit refusals.；Do not present e2e/static labels as runtime proof.；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：Static capability output is compatibility metadata only, while the host contract require scope/environment/availability evidence and keep historical quality independent of write capability.；闭环处置：Retain the empirical prerequisite. Keep static/pre-init/e2e historical quality as HistoricalQuality.Unknown internally and expose the existing shape only as compatibility metadata for the public data leaf. A recorded observation must bind venue, endpoint, public data context (or an explicitly declared account context), instrument, interval, source timestamps, observedAt, and freshness criteria before HistoricalQuality.Proven can satisfy a stronger quality or finality gate; static arrays never become write permission or a global action map.；边界证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts:1290-1296 returns static CRYPTO/CRYPTO_PERP, MKT/LMT, and historicalBars=realtime, while CcxtBroker.spec.ts:1679-1688 checks only the static arrays and does not observe venue quality. Composition contract K11-K12 require runtime evidence before advertising native/finality guarantees.


### 跨组契约与补充发现

> 原调查：Source architecture fact (not a target requirement): `CcxtBroker` currently implements the legacy `IBroker<CcxtBrokerMeta>` and routes several operations through the process-wide `exchangeOverrides` registry/default helpers. The corrected target treats this class/registry as migration input and composes independent provider leaves; it does not require a universal IBroker or global action switch.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 IBroker class 与 process-wide exchangeOverrides 作为迁移输入，目标由 provider leaf 自己声明可用操作与 schema，不建立 universal IBroker/action switch。

> 原调查：Source boundary fact: `CcxtBroker.spec.ts:48-49` is import/contract-extension glue. Future tests should exercise declared schema/codec leaves and compatibility projections without treating raw SDK mocks as runtime proof.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 spec import/contract-extension glue 移到 adapter/protocol boundary；domain codec 只消费已认证 slot，raw SDK mock 不再冒充 runtime evidence。

> 原调查：Source boundary fact: `CcxtBroker.ts:156-162` defines `CcxtBrokerMeta` and class self-registration. The target registration point may publish typed Ccxt provider metadata and leaf declarations, but no production module or new export is claimed by this design.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 class metadata/self-registration 作为 pack loading evidence；注册只使 provider definition 可发现，不授予 operation、permission、idempotency 或 native guarantee。

> 原调查：Public/account scope rule: public Candle/Instrument/News-like data does not receive a fabricated AccountScope. AccountScope is required for account, position, order, and controlled-effect facts; a concrete data schema may choose `Public` or explicit `Account(AccountScope)`.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-ACCOUNT](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-account)。保留 Public 与 AccountScope 的分离：账户 PnL/position observation 显式声明 scope，public market leaf 不构造账户字段或 private authority。

> 原调查：CCXT has no evidenced push stream in the assigned files. Any future stream adapter must declare frame/control schemas, lifecycle, cursor/replay and backpressure under K05 rather than treating polling pulls as push or transactionizing each frame.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-DATA](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-data)。把 future stream 作为待实证 provider leaf；当前 source 只证明 finite pull，不能把 realtime label 当作 push quality/finality。

> 原调查：K01/K02 provider composition: CcxtCore exposes a provider pack whose fixed UTA-facing CapabilityDescriptor envelope is computed from each declared connection, catalog, market-data, account-observation, order-observation, or controlled-effect leaf. The source CcxtBroker IBroker class and exchange override switch remain migration evidence only; the target has no universal SDK or mandatory handler.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 CcxtBroker/override switch 留在迁移证据，当前 foundation 只组合 provider leaves 与固定 outer descriptor；不建立 universal IBroker 或 global action map。

> 原调查：K03 schema boundary: CCXT native rows/config/replies enter through provider-declared schemas and codecs. Static CcxtMarket/FundingRate/OrderBook/legacy Contract types are compatibility projections; exact native extensions, units, error variants, and schema fingerprints stay with the leaf.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 CcxtMarket/FundingRate/OrderBook/legacy Contract 的静态 shape 留作 adapter projection，construction-bound schema 同时派生 validator、metadata、slot 与 digest。

> 原调查：K04 semantic units: Instrument, Candle, and other data units are account-independent unless their concrete operation declares Account context. Order effects compose provider-declared sizing, kind, duration, relations, protection, and native fields; legal combinations are not global and no Cartesian order variant list is required.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 Order/Candle/Instrument 的 semantic unit 与 provider HOF/schema 关系落到 core foundation；合法组合由声明决定，不生成 Cartesian order variants，AccountScope 只在所需事实/效果上出现。

> 原调查：K05 data delivery: CCXT quote, bar, funding, order-book, session, catalog, account, position, and listing reads are finite pull observations (no CCXT push source is evidenced here). Public reads use `dataContext: Public`; account reads carry explicit AccountScope. Their caches/projections have observation completeness and resource lifecycles, not order prepare/approve/compensate or per-frame WAL.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-DATA](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-data)。把 CCXT reads 归入 finite Pull/data observation；`Complete|Partial|Unavailable` 是唯一 Coverage，value/quality unknown 是 payload/reason，ordinary data 不进入 order WAL。

> 原调查：K06 outer projection: `index.ts` and provider tools project declared leaves into describe/help/call schemas. Public data tools do not invent an account selector; account/order tools resolve an explicit scope, and no raw Exchange/SDK DTO crosses the public boundary.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 index/tools 当作同一 provider tree 的 generated projection；public leaf 不伪造 account selector，account/order leaf 使用 explicit scope，raw SDK DTO 不跨 public boundary。

> 原调查：K07 heterogeneous bridge: the CCXT adapter preserves venue-native endpoints, options, namespace parameters and override sequencing behind typed provider leaves. Endpoint presence never implies idempotency, atomicity, or compensation; native protocol failures remain distinct from input/domain/output failures.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-VENUES-OVERRIDES](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-venues-overrides)。把 native endpoint/options/namespace/override sequencing 留在 selected provider interpreter；foreign/protocol failures 与 input/domain/output failures 分离，method presence 不证明 idempotency/atomicity。

> 原调查：K08 controlled effects: only provider-declared order-effect leaves use the transaction writer for prepared intent, approval, dispatch, acknowledgement, observation, and recovery. CCXT create/edit/cancel/close source methods are not authority; data-query failures never trigger order compensation.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-EFFECTS](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-effects)。把只有 provider-declared effect leaf 才能获得 writer/admission/dispatch/observation/recovery 的关系落在 core controlled-effect section；source create/edit/cancel/close 不构成 authority。

> 原调查：K09/K10 trigger boundary: CcxtCore supplies data observations and any declared effect result; trigger binding, activation, ReturnToAgent review/outbox, and agent delivery belong to their owning groups. A public candle event is evidence, not approval, and no CcxtCore leaf dispatches on an event by itself.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-EFFECTS](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-effects)。把 CcxtCore 的 data observations/effect results 与 trigger owner 分离；public Candle event 仅是 evidence，不能由 CCXT leaf 自行 dispatch，ReturnToAgent 不是 universal default。

> 原调查：K11 evidence reuse: the 74 MAP entries preserve current CCXT source behavior, exact venue facts, compatibility defects, and six unresolved empirical obligations. The revised target does not claim that mocked/gated tests prove native quality, idempotency, persistence, or runtime capability.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 74 MAP 的 source facts 与六项 empirical obligations 继续作为 evidence；mock/gated tests 不升级为 native quality、idempotency、persistence 或 runtime capability proof。

> 原调查：K12 acceptance: experiments must separately falsify public pull schema/provenance, catalog identity, namespace completeness, and each enabled controlled effect. Adding a provider field must change its descriptor-derived type/validation/help; absent native capability must remove the leaf, not manufacture an Unsupported method.

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-CORE-FOUNDATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-core-foundation)。把 acceptance 约束为 declaration-derived type/validator/help、catalog identity、namespace completeness 与 each enabled effect 的 falsifiers；absent native capability 结构缺席而非 Unsupported stub。

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-2FB8A60A26 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A8**

> 各 venue 的 native market id 是否稳定且与 unified symbol 是否一一对应需按连接 conformance 采样；在未证明前 catalog 只接受明确 identity evidence。

旧行为/证据：defaultPlaceOrder 直接把 symbol、string type、buy/sell、number amount、optional price 与 Record params 传给 createOrder，返回 raw CcxtOrder；没有 durable intent/dispatch identity/ack versus observation distinction。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 defaultPlaceOrder 的普通 market/limit native call 仍可作为 provider adapter implementation，但 cashQty/notional 的 quote conversion 必须把该 provider 的 quote identity、rounding/lot policy 和实际 units 固定进 plan。；保留 source 接受的 stop/TP/SL input 与明确拒绝 TRAIL/TRAIL LIMIT、未验证 attached TP/SL 的安全意图；target 由 provider leaf schema 表达是否支持，不伪造跨 provider 支持。；provider leaf 未声明的 relations/TIF/session/trailing variant 不出现在 input schema 或 command；已声明且接受的 provider-native fields 不因 CCXT 不能表达而静默丢弃。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：createOrder 的 raw params 需要 provider-declared order schema/HOF 组合，而不是全局订单组合全集/动作表；target 仅把 durable transaction wrapper 放在受控效果边界。；闭环处置：保留逐 venue client-identity conformance。provider order leaf 只能声明并接受其精确 native fields/relations；未声明的 trailing/protection/relation variant 不出现在 schema 或 command，已声明但未取得稳定 client id、lookup/retention 和 idempotency scope 证据时，remote timeout/response loss 只进入 Unknown/RecoveryRequired/observe，绝不重发 createOrder；已接受的字段不得因 CCXT 限制而静默丢弃。；边界证据：overrides.ts:185-196 的 defaultPlaceOrder 直接把 raw symbol/type/side/amount/price/params 交给 createOrder；没有 client order id、retention 或 idempotency evidence，raw Ack 也不区分 fill/outcome。

**MAP-6AAB1AB711 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> 各 venue positions 是否全账户、是否分页、mark/PnL 是否权威需实测；未有 evidence 不能标 Complete。

旧行为/证据：defaultFetchPositions 没有参数/selector/schema，直接执行 exchange.fetchPositions() 并把 raw position rows 返回；没有 AccountScope、observation timestamp、完整性或 query failure。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 default route 仍可供 venue 明确证明统一 positions endpoint 的 adapter 使用。；原始 venue position semantics 在 adapter-specific decoder 保留；不把所有 exchange 强制成同一种字段假设。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：positions 是 scope-bound data listing；target 保留 row/schema/coverage evidence 与 Partial/Unavailable，不引入订单 approval/compensation。；闭环处置：保留 venue positions conformance。没有 scope、pagination、row schema、mark/PnL provenance 的完整 evidence 时，PositionListing 只能 Partial/Unavailable，保留已知 quantity/instrument/signed facts，不写 zero exposure，不执行 absence/Complete projection，也不把 mark/PnL 未证实地当 accounting precondition。；边界证据：overrides.ts:198-201 的 defaultFetchPositions 无 scope/selector/schema，直接返回 raw fetchPositions rows；source 没有各 venue 全账户范围、分页边界或 mark/PnL authority evidence。

**MAP-A1AE3F307F · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> OKX 实测证据的 SDK/endpoint/account version 与 retention horizon 需记录；其他 venue 必须逐一 probe。

旧行为/证据：defaultFetchAllOpenOrders 只调用一次 exchange.fetchOpenOrders()；注释记录 live OKX pending endpoint 返回 spot+swap，但明确 CCXT 没有跨 venue completeness semantics，category-scoped venue 需 override。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 OKX 单次 endpoint 的已实测覆盖可继续作为 OKX-specific policy，但不是全局默认 guarantee。；category-scoped venue 仍由独立 override 执行。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：OKX 单次 open-order 证据只能绑定具体 adapter/version/account；target 保留 per-venue coverage leaf 与逐订单 observe，不把 default helper 当跨 provider guarantee。；闭环处置：保留逐 venue probe。OKX policy 只有连同 SDK/endpoint/account version、scope、cursor/absence coverage 与 retention evidence 才可声明 Complete；其他 venue 默认 Partial/Unavailable，不能从 OKX comment 推广 guarantee，缺席仍需 per-order observe。；边界证据：overrides.ts:203-213 的注释只把单次 unscoped fetchOpenOrders 覆盖绑定到 OKX live comment，并明确 CCXT 不提供跨 venue completeness semantics；source 没有完整 OKX evidence record，也没有其他 venue probes。

**MAP-AB05DEE8D4 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> 每个注册 venue 的 account-family、jurisdiction、idempotency、coverage 与 optional wallet 事实需 live conformance 固定；未证实能力保持 unavailable。

旧行为/证据：registry 在 Binance override 中声明 spot 与 derivatives（walletTypes future+delivery，delivery 注释 tolerated-on-failure），并以四个 exchange key 注册 Binance、Bitget、Bybit、Hyperliquid；没有 SDK/account-family/jurisdiction/version/capability context。；本节关系：把 optional hooks 与 registry 只作为 provider pack loading/interpreter selection；每个 default/override 自带 schema、availability、permission、failure、recovery policy，hook 存在不等于安全、幂等或原子。针对该 MAP 的具体处置：保留 现有四个 exchange registrations 与 Binance future+delivery merge 意图保留；Binance delivery tolerated-on-failure 仅在显式 optional policy 下保留。；Bitget/Bybit/Hyperliquid modules 继续独立，不把 venue-specific behavior 塞进 kernel switch；family 未证明时保持 unavailable。；变化后以当前章节的 typed schema、scope/identity、coverage 与 effect/recovery ownership 承载这些字段，而不是把旧的 nullable/cast/default/registry 行为提升为 host 保证。来源裁决摘要：string registry 与 Binance wallet merge 是 source facts；target 改为 versioned registration/capability descriptors，保留 optional delivery 与各 venue family，禁止 registry presence 代替 leaf availability。；闭环处置：保留 registration conformance。Typed VenueAccountRegistration 必须为每个 venue/version/environment/family/scope 写入 live evidence；registry presence 仅允许装配 adapter，未证实的 read/action/optional-wallet capability 保持 Unavailable/Partial。Binance delivery 的 tolerated-on-failure 只能是显式 OptionalNamespace，不能把四个 exchange keys、默认 family 或缺失 wallet 当完整账户/安全重试证明。；边界证据：overrides.ts:215-234 的 registry 是 string-keyed Record，实际四个 exchange keys，Binance value 另含 future/delivery wallet definitions；source 没有 per registration family/jurisdiction/idempotency/coverage/entitlement live facts。

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-VENUES-CATALOG](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-venues-catalog)。marketToContract 的 unknown cast 与 contractSize=1 fallback 改为 native schema 解码和 derivative metadata failure/Unavailable，不把 fallback multiplier 写入 Instrument。

> 原调查：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/ccxt-contracts.ts:118-122: contractToCcxt 接受 exchangeName 但函数体不使用它；catalog lookup 必须将 VenueIdentity 纳入 key，防止同 symbol 在不同 exchange 间误命中。

**当前承接：** [LCCXT-VENUES-CATALOG](legacy-accommodation.md#lccxt-venues-catalog)。contractToCcxt 未使用 exchangeName 的旧签名不能丢掉 venue identity；catalog key 必须包含 VenueIdentity 与 native key，防止同 symbol 跨 exchange 误命中。

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-F4D1FDCBB6 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2**

> The current source does not expose a reliable TWS paper/live environment callback; implementation must choose an explicit observed endpoint/account evidence source rather than infer from port.

原问题保留为：The current source does not expose a reliable TWS paper/live environment callback; implementation must choose an explicit observed endpoint/account evidence source rather than infer from port.。原调查证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts:76-101 accepts paper and port configuration, but fromConfig does not carry paper into the constructed broker; the port is configuration only.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts:182-219 connects, selects an account, and waits for the first account download without exposing an authenticated paper/live observation.；docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k02 and #k07-k08 require endpoint/environment evidence and separate capability/readiness/dispatch authority; port or testnet hints cannot authorize a write.。当前承接关系（LSDK-IBKR-CONNECTION）：把环境、credential、SDK response/version、probe 与 release 作为 connection/foreign-boundary evidence；port、fixture、GC 或 probe 只能是 hint，未绑定的环境、服务或远端结果不得进入 write admission。 在 provider evidence 到来前保持 Unknown、Partial 或 Unavailable，并阻止不满足前置条件的受控 dispatch；不得用类型、mock 或默认值填空。

**MAP-7BA90560A5 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4**

> TWS managedAccounts only supplies account codes in current bridge; sub-account/jurisdiction metadata must come from a verified account observation source.

原问题保留为：TWS managedAccounts only supplies account codes in current bridge; sub-account/jurisdiction metadata must come from a verified account observation source.。原调查证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:454-457 splits managedAccounts and stores only accounts[0] as accountId.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:604-657 receives accountName in portfolio/account callbacks but names it _accountName and stores values/positions without sub-account or jurisdiction metadata.；docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k02,#k04,#k07-k08 require explicit account scope for account facts/effects while public data remains Public; missing scope cannot authorize mutation.。当前承接关系（LSDK-IBKR-CONNECTION）：把 managed-account token、accountName、sub-account、jurisdiction 与 environment 放进 revisioned AccountDirectory/AccountScope provenance；不确定时保留 opaque identity 与 scope pending，不选择首项或推断账户。 在 provider evidence 到来前保持 Unknown、Partial 或 Unavailable，并阻止不满足前置条件的受控 dispatch；不得用类型、mock 或默认值填空。

**MAP-5F63915F5B · 由主机契约决定 · A1, A2, A6**

> The source uses aliceId as a field but does not establish its runtime relation to conId; require evidence before making it a domain identity.

原问题保留为：The source uses aliceId as a field but does not establish its runtime relation to conId; require evidence before making it a domain identity.。原调查证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:509-544 constructs and parses aliceId as {utaId}|{nativeKey}, verifies the UTA prefix, and delegates native-key resolution.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts:891-917 uses numeric conId as the canonical native key and treats a bare symbol as an STK routing convenience rather than an unambiguous non-STK identity.；docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k03-k04 keep native instrument identity and aliases as distinct typed records; an alias cannot substitute for canonical identity or account scope.。当前承接关系（LSDK-IBKR-CATALOG）：把 native identity、ContractDetails 字段、calendar/expiry/venue 与 resolved facts 分层；只有 provider catalog evidence 建立的 canonical identity/coverage 才能成为 tradeable leaf，缺失或冲突不得进入受控 effect。 主机关系已经固定为上述表示；provider evidence 只决定当前 availability/coverage，不增加新的 kernel variant。

**MAP-86EFC621F8 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A6**

> IBKR client-side idempotency guarantees for replaying the same dispatch identity are not established; automatic resend remains forbidden without evidence.

原问题保留为：IBKR client-side idempotency guarantees for replaying the same dispatch identity are not established; automatic resend remains forbidden without evidence.。原调查证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts:491-498 allocates a local orderId, registers a request, calls placeOrder, and awaits the callback; this source path does not establish venue deduplication for a replayed dispatch identity.；docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k08-k10 distinguishes known rejection from Unknown, preserves DispatchStarted/recovery ownership, and forbids treating a post-boundary timeout as rejection or silently continuing.；docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k07-k08 separates connectivity/readiness from effect authority; generation/request identity is not DispatchId and restoration cannot permit transaction resend.。当前承接关系（LSDK-IBKR-EFFECT）：把该事实约束在 provider-specific schema-bound leaf；缺失证据保持 Unknown/Unavailable，不扩展为跨 provider guarantee。 在 provider evidence 到来前保持 Unknown、Partial 或 Unavailable，并阻止不满足前置条件的受控 dispatch；不得用类型、mock 或默认值填空。

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-9FCA9EFBE0 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A8**

> IBKR managed account callback 是否始终提供 accountName 未由本地源证明；缺失时必须由连接选定 AccountScope 注入并保留 provenance。

原问题保留为：IBKR managed account callback 是否始终提供 accountName 未由本地源证明；缺失时必须由连接选定 AccountScope 注入并保留 provenance。。原调查证据：request-bridge.ts:454-457 retains only the first managed-account token, while updatePortfolio/updateAccountValue/accountDownloadEnd receive accountName at :604-660; C01/K02 require explicit AccountScope and reject inferred defaults.。当前承接关系（LSDK-IBKR-ACCOUNT-DATA）：把账户回调的 scope、currency bucket、BASE、observedAt/sequence、quality 与 closure/coverage evidence 保留在 AccountData leaf；缺失、零值或 provisional 不升级为 Complete，也不获得执行许可。 在 provider evidence 到来前保持 Unknown、Partial 或 Unavailable，并阻止不满足前置条件的受控 dispatch；不得用类型、mock 或默认值填空。

**MAP-96192FAD43 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A8**

> 测试 payload 的 SDK 版本兼容性需在实现 slice 锁定；当前不声称已验证。

原问题保留为：测试 payload 的 SDK 版本兼容性需在实现 slice 锁定；当前不声称已验证。。原调查证据：request-bridge.spec.ts:5 imports @traderalice/ibkr and lines 21-58 exercise only the greeting/nextValidId fixture; no runtime or ABI compatibility observation is present.。当前承接关系（LSDK-IBKR-BRIDGE-CORRELATION）：把该事实约束在 generation-scoped typed callback correlation 与 delivery terminal；旧代和未映射证据不得改变当前状态，缺失 coverage 时保持 Partial/Unavailable。 在 provider evidence 到来前保持 Unknown、Partial 或 Unavailable，并阻止不满足前置条件的受控 dispatch；不得用类型、mock 或默认值填空。

**MAP-E1E35E6D53 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A6, A8**

> SDK 在 close 后是否仍会异步发 nextValidId 未由 wrapper 证明，必须以 attempt token 丢弃。

原问题保留为：SDK 在 close 后是否仍会异步发 nextValidId 未由 wrapper 证明，必须以 attempt token 丢弃。。原调查证据：request-bridge.spec.ts:60-91 destroys the socket and observes prompt handshake rejection, but it does not establish whether the SDK emits late nextValidId callbacks after close.。当前承接关系（LSDK-IBKR-BRIDGE-CORRELATION）：把 native code、callback/request identity、generation、timestamp/sequence、snapshot-end 与 send-boundary evidence 保留在 typed bridge correlation；旧代、未知结果或歧义只产生 Stale/Unknown/Observe evidence，不改变权限或终态。 在 provider evidence 到来前保持 Unknown、Partial 或 Unavailable，并阻止不满足前置条件的受控 dispatch；不得用类型、mock 或默认值填空。

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-7805D80DA1 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A6, A8**

> Native response envelope/version and deterministic accepted-before-ack injection remain to be fixed by the adapter conformance harness.

原问题保留为：Native response envelope/version and deterministic accepted-before-ack injection remain to be fixed by the adapter conformance harness.。原调查证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:1-45 only mocks numeric enums, promise-returning contexts, and a limited method surface; it provides no native response envelope/version or independent remote ledger.；../composition-contract.md K03-K07-K08-K11-K12 requires runtime native schema validation, an isolated heterogeneous boundary, and explicit unknown handling after the dispatch barrier.；entries.md#map-7805d80da1 preserves this fixture limitation as an empirical obligation and does not treat mock behavior as native evidence.。当前承接关系（LSDK-LB-CONNECTION）：把环境、credential、SDK response/version、probe 与 release 作为 connection/foreign-boundary evidence；port、fixture、GC 或 probe 只能是 hint，未绑定的环境、服务或远端结果不得进入 write admission。 在 provider evidence 到来前保持 Unknown、Partial 或 Unavailable，并阻止不满足前置条件的受控 dispatch；不得用类型、mock 或默认值填空。

**MAP-ABF45B8D66 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A6, A8**

> SDK error code/status and probe coverage of quote endpoint remain empirical conformance facts.

原问题保留为：SDK error code/status and probe coverage of quote endpoint remain empirical conformance facts.。原调查证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:235-275 proves only credential checks, an empty accountBalance probe, and message-regex 401 retry behavior; it does not establish native code/status mapping or quote probe coverage.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts:180-228 constructs trade and quote contexts but probes only tradeCtx.accountBalance().；../composition-contract.md K02-K03-K07 requires per-leaf availability, schema-bound native failure handling, and a fixed UTA-facing boundary.。当前承接关系（LSDK-LB-CONNECTION）：把环境、credential、SDK response/version、probe 与 release 作为 connection/foreign-boundary evidence；port、fixture、GC 或 probe 只能是 hint，未绑定的环境、服务或远端结果不得进入 write admission。 在 provider evidence 到来前保持 Unknown、Partial 或 Unavailable，并阻止不满足前置条件的受控 dispatch；不得用类型、mock 或默认值填空。

| 保留 | 来源 services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts:21-81。实际旧字段/行为：测试用 Decimal 验证 market quantity、全平删除和部分减法，断言的是内存 Position。。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-MOCK-ORDER`（MockBroker：订单叶子、状态观察与纯会计 reducer）规定的具体关系：Mock provider 只发布 exact declared leaves：`place`（MKT/LMT/STP，StopLimit absent）、可选 `amend`、`cancel`、`close`。Input 使用 `MockPlaceInput`/`MockAmendment`/`MockCancelInput`/`MockCloseInput`，OrderRef 带 AccountScope 与 opaque broker/client ID；expectedOrderVersion/exposureVersion 是显式 CAS。Output 区分 Ack/Working/Filled/Cancelled/Unknown；read lookup 是 Found/AbsentWithEvidence/Unknown/Malformed。WAC/short/multiplier 是 pure reducers，不等于 native venue semantics。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Retain exact Decimal quantity, partial/full close and WAC behavior.；Do not promote the SDK Decimal or map position to the public contract.；本 section 的具体变更为 Place schema 以 tagged order kind 与 Quantity/Price units 构造；provider capabilities omit StopLimit until trigger→working-limit semantics exists。；modify/cancel 叶子若启用，要求 expected order version、scope、opaque ID；amend fields 为 Retain/Set，返回 Ack then observation。；close 输入显式 `All\|QuantityTarget`、target/policy/expiry/exposure version；opposite market reducer 只是 Mock implementation，不冒充 reduce-only/atomicity。；Order observations 不在 read 时 mutate SDK object；Partial fill 记录 original requested, cumulative/leaves, execution identity, price/time。；missing/invalid multiplier 是 typed Unavailable/Invalid；WAC reducer 对 oversell/short/mixed exposures 返回 explicit error/incomplete。；不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。；新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：pure match/reduce functions 在 test layer 内；controlled mock effect 仍走 writer permission/Dispatch barriers。；read/list/order projection 是 data pulls，失败不补偿；DurableMockVenue 才提供 remote outcome/restart proof。；AccountScope、InstrumentId、ExposureKey、BrokerOrderId/ClientOrderId、DispatchId distinct。。切换：先拆 exact input/output/error codecs 与 pure reducers，再迁移 existing order/account tests to scoped fixture leaves。；删除 Partial SDK mutation, null success/failure, default multiplier/mark, lossy clone and generic legacy PlaceOrderResult authority。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts:21-81](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts#L21-L81) |

`MockPlaceInput`/`MockAmendment`/`MockCancelInput`/`MockCloseInput`，OrderRef 带 AccountScope 与 opaque broker/client ID；expectedOrderVersion/exposureVersion 是显式 CAS。Output 区分 Ack/Working/Filled/Cancelled/Unknown；read lookup 是 Found/AbsentWithEvidence/Unknown/Malformed。WAC/short/multiplier 是 pure reducers，不等于 native venue semantics。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Retain short OPT/STK and mixed signed aggregation.；Retain entry-mark netLiq/PnL equations.；本 section 的具体变更为 Place schema 以 tagged order kind 与 Quantity/Price units 构造；provider capabilities omit StopLimit until trigger→working-limit semantics exists。；modify/cancel 叶子若启用，要求 expected order version、scope、opaque ID；amend fields 为 Retain/Set，返回 Ack then observation。；close 输入显式 `All\|QuantityTarget`、target/policy/expiry/exposure version；opposite market reducer 只是 Mock implementation，不冒充 reduce-only/atomicity。；Order observations 不在 read 时 mutate SDK object；Partial fill 记录 original requested, cumulative/leaves, execution identity, price/time。；missing/invalid multiplier 是 typed Unavailable/Invalid；WAC reducer 对 oversell/short/mixed exposures 返回 explicit error/incomplete。；不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。；新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：pure match/reduce functions 在 test layer 内；controlled mock effect 仍走 writer permission/Dispatch barriers。；read/list/order projection 是 data pulls，失败不补偿；DurableMockVenue 才提供 remote outcome/restart proof。；AccountScope、InstrumentId、ExposureKey、BrokerOrderId/ClientOrderId、DispatchId distinct。。切换：先拆 exact input/output/error codecs 与 pure reducers，再迁移 existing order/account tests to scoped fixture leaves。；删除 Partial SDK mutation, null success/failure, default multiplier/mark, lossy clone and generic legacy PlaceOrderResult authority。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts:650-730](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts#L650-L730) |
| <a id="map-9dfd3b9879"></a>[MAP-9DFD3B9879](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/MockBroker/analyses.json) | [LVENUE-MOCK-HARNESS](legacy-accommodation.md#lvenue-mock-harness) · A2, A3, A4, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 来源 services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts:1-38。实际旧字段/行为：一个 class 同时承担旧 IBroker facade、native SDK translation、volatile ledger、query 与 simulator controls。。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-MOCK-HARNESS`（MockBroker：测试 Layer、生命周期与故障注入）规定的具体关系：Mock 不是全局 IBroker conformance，而是 provider-scoped declaration fixtures。`MockLayer` 为 Public/Account/Instrument scopes 提供 typed leaves；若要验证 durable semantics，另建独立 `DurableMockVenue` 与 JournalWriter/CAS/remote ledger。`CallRecord`、FailurePlan、InitialLedger、RemoteObservationFixture 都是 test support，不能冒充 native guarantees。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Retain deterministic Mock fixtures with explicit seed/provenance and SDK mapping inside adapter/fact layers; 关系：`LVENUE-MOCK-ORDER`（MockBroker：订单叶子、状态观察与纯会计 reducer）规定的具体关系：Mock provider 只发布 exact declared leaves：`place`（MKT/LMT/STP，StopLimit absent）、可选 `amend`、`cancel`、`close`。Input 使用 `MockPlaceInput`/`MockAmendment`/`MockCancelInput`/`MockCloseInput`，OrderRef 带 AccountScope 与 opaque broker/client ID；expectedOrderVersion/exposureVersion 是显式 CAS。Output 区分 Ack/Working/Filled/Cancelled/Unknown；read lookup 是 Found/AbsentWithEvidence/Unknown/Malformed。WAC/short/multiplier 是 pure reducers，不等于 native venue semantics。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Retain market/limit, observation。；close 输入显式 `All\|QuantityTarget`、target/policy/expiry/exposure version；opposite market reducer 只是 Mock implementation，不冒充 reduce-only/atomicity。；Order observations 不在 read 时 mutate SDK object；Partial fill 记录 original requested, cumulative/leaves, execution identity, price/time。；missing/invalid multiplier 是 typed Unavailable/Invalid；WAC reducer 对 oversell/short/mixed exposures 返回 explicit error/incomplete。；不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。；新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：pure match/reduce functions 在 test layer 内；controlled mock effect 仍走 writer permission/Dispatch barriers。；read/list/order projection 是 data pulls，失败不补偿；DurableMockVenue 才提供 remote outcome/restart proof。；AccountScope、InstrumentId、ExposureKey、BrokerOrderId/ClientOrderId、DispatchId distinct。。切换：先拆 exact input/output/error codecs 与 pure reducers，再迁移 existing order/account tests to scoped fixture leaves。；删除 Partial SDK mutation, null success/failure, default multiplier/mark, lossy clone and generic legacy PlaceOrderResult authority。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts:278-325](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts#L278-L325) |

关系：`LVENUE-MOCK-ORDER`（MockBroker：订单叶子、状态观察与纯会计 reducer）规定的具体关系：Mock provider 只发布 exact declared leaves：`place`（MKT/LMT/STP，StopLimit absent）、可选 `amend`、`cancel`、`close`。Input 使用 `MockPlaceInput`/`MockAmendment`/`MockCancelInput`/`MockCloseInput`，OrderRef 带 AccountScope 与 opaque broker/client ID；expectedOrderVersion/exposureVersion 是显式 CAS。Output 区分 Ack/Working/Filled/Cancelled/Unknown；read lookup 是 Found/AbsentWithEvidence/Unknown/Malformed。WAC/short/multiplier 是 pure reducers，不等于 native venue semantics。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Retain cash/PnL/netLiq and signed valuation equations.；Keep fixture provenance explicit.；本 section 的具体变更为 Place schema 以 tagged order kind 与 Quantity/Price units 构造；provider capabilities omit StopLimit until trigger→working-limit semantics exists。；modify/cancel 叶子若启用，要求 expected order version、scope、opaque ID；amend fields 为 Retain/Set，返回 Ack then observation。；close 输入显式 `All\|QuantityTarget`、target/policy/expiry/exposure version；opposite market reducer 只是 Mock implementation，不冒充 reduce-only/atomicity。；Order observations 不在 read 时 mutate SDK object；Partial fill 记录 original requested, cumulative/leaves, execution identity, price/time。；missing/invalid multiplier 是 typed Unavailable/Invalid；WAC reducer 对 oversell/short/mixed exposures 返回 explicit error/incomplete。；不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。；新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：pure match/reduce functions 在 test layer 内；controlled mock effect 仍走 writer permission/Dispatch barriers。；read/list/order projection 是 data pulls，失败不补偿；DurableMockVenue 才提供 remote outcome/restart proof。；AccountScope、InstrumentId、ExposureKey、BrokerOrderId/ClientOrderId、DispatchId distinct。。切换：先拆 exact input/output/error codecs 与 pure reducers，再迁移 existing order/account tests to scoped fixture leaves。；删除 Partial SDK mutation, null success/failure, default multiplier/mark, lossy clone and generic legacy PlaceOrderResult authority。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts:387-415](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts#L387-L415) |

A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 来源 services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts:546-578。实际旧字段/行为：setMarkPrice/tickPrice volatile，tick 触发 matcher；getMarkPrice returns Decimal\|null。。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-MOCK-SIMULATOR`（MockBroker：外部事实、估值与独立 durable venue harness）规定的具体关系：外部事实用 tagged source schemas：`PriceFact`、`FillFact`、`CancellationFact`、`BalanceTransferFact`、`ExternalExecutionFact`，每个带 source/sequence/as-of/scope/identity。纯 `Decision<State,Command,Event,ExternalEffect,Failure>`/`Evolution` reducers 只消费已构造事实；`AccountProjection` 的 `coverage` 仍输出 `Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable`，估值质量另以 `ValuationStatus=Complete\|Incomplete\|DerivedUnavailable` payload/reason 表达。需验证 crash/restart 时使用 independent `DurableMockVenue`/remote ledger 与 `JournalWriter`，不把 simulator map 当本地/远程唯一账本。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete\|Partial\|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Retain deterministic mark/tick matching utility.；Do not expose transaction map authority.；本 section 的具体变更为 所有 control API 产出 versioned fact/evidence，按 source identity/sequence 去重；不直接隐写 decision-bearing state。；manual partial fill 保持 original request 与 cumulative/leaves；cancel/fill 是 distinct event variants，不能通过删除 map row 表示。；account override 改为 typed `RemoteObservationFixture`/scenario input，带 scope/as-of/source，不能永久遮挡 cash/positions reconciliation。；external events 进入 data/reconciliation projection；只有显式 controlled command + permission 才能产生交易 effect。；pure reducer 对 missing mark/FX/multiplier 返回 incomplete/unknown；不得使用 default 100/1 或将 failed calculation 清零。；估值 reducer 区分 broker-reported、verified same-currency FX 与 policy-approved Estimated display；未知 FX/mark/multiplier 不用 1 或 0 冒充完整，但已验证的一比一关系可保留。。权属：Simulator fact source、Mock proof。；AccountScope、InstrumentId、ExposureKey、BrokerOrderId/ClientOrderId、DispatchId distinct。。切换：先拆 exact input/output/error codecs 与 pure reducers，再迁移 existing order/account tests to scoped fixture Completed/Failed/Cancelled；不要承诺 crash 后 final frame。；若数据触发 deferred invocation，使用纯 `advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary)` 与 durable checkpoint；一个 not-started revision 只有一个 activation owner，事件证据不能越级授权。。切换：先把 setters/seed/failure controls 改成 typed fact source 与 pure reducers，再增加 optional durable remote harness for crash specimens。；删除 ad hoc snapshot/override/map mutation as sole ### 跨组契约与补充发现

> 原调查：Mock contributes provider-scoped declaration leaves and exact schemas; the current IBroker/global switch remains source evidence only. The target has no universal closed action set, no mandatory placeholder leaf for every operation and no Unsupported-filled universal SDK.

**当前承接：** [LVENUE-MOCK-HARNESS](legacy-accommodation.md#lvenue-mock-harness)。实际旧边界行为：MockBroker class 同时持有 legacy facade、native translation、mutable ledger、queries、simulator controls、CallRecord 与 method/count failure injector；factory/Partial/override 可直接安装 arbitrary state。init/close 只改 promise/call log，restart/worker/lease/remote unknown 不存在。。该跨组 finding 原文：Mock contributes provider-scoped declaration leaves and exact schemas; the current IBroker/global switch remains source evidence only. The target has no universal closed action set, no mandatory placeholder leaf for every operation and no Unsupported-filled universal SDK.。当前具体关系：Mock 不是全局 IBroker conformance，而是 provider-scoped declaration fixtures。`MockLayer` 为 Public/Account/Instrument scopes 提供 typed leaves；若要验证 durable semantics，另建独立 `DurableMockVenue` 与 JournalWriter/CAS/remote ledger。`CallRecord`、FailurePlan、InitialLedger、RemoteObservationFixture 都是 test support，不能冒充 native guarantees。；由 `LVENUE-MOCK-HARNESS` 的 scope/schema/effect 规则落实，保留 native unknown，不把文本或资源存在当作 guarantee。

> 原调查：Each declared leaf composes its semantic unit, input/result/error schema, native extension and resource requirements. Provider-specific HOFs preserve exact extensions; structural absence removes unsupported leaves and empty parents.

**当前承接：** [LVENUE-MOCK-HARNESS](legacy-accommodation.md#lvenue-mock-harness)。实际旧边界行为：MockBroker class 同时持有 legacy facade、native translation、mutable ledger、queries、simulator controls、CallRecord 与 method/count failure injector；factory/Partial/override 可直接安装 arbitrary state。init/close 只改 promise/call log，restart/worker/lease/remote unknown 不存在。。该跨组 finding 原文：Each declared leaf composes its semantic unit, input/result/error schema, native extension and resource requirements. Provider-specific HOFs preserve exact extensions; structural absence removes unsupported leaves and empty parents.。当前具体关系：Mock 不是全局 IBroker conformance，而是 provider-scoped declaration fixtures。`MockLayer` 为 Public/Account/Instrument scopes 提供 typed leaves；若要验证 durable semantics，另建独立 `DurableMockVenue` 与 JournalWriter/CAS/remote ledger。`CallRecord`、FailurePlan、InitialLedger、RemoteObservationFixture 都是 test support，不能冒充 native guarantees。；由 `LVENUE-MOCK-HARNESS` 的 scope/schema/effect 规则落实，保留 native unknown，不把文本或资源存在当作 guarantee。

> 原调查：Only controlled trading effects use withTransaction and durable intent/approval/dispatch/recovery. Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup data units, account/position/order reads, pull results and push streams do not inherit order WAL, approval or compensation.

> 原调查：AccountScope is required only by account/order facts, order references, execution intent and related conflicts/authorization; public Instrument/Candle/News/NewsGroup and ordinary market-data leaves use their own declared Public/venue/instrument scope. Canonical identities, metadata versions and source/sequence evidence remain boundary facts. Native protocols, SDK classes and provider extensions stay inside the adapter; no native idempotency, absence, atomicity or reversibility guarantee is invented.

It exercises the old IBroker facade, not a durable UTA runtime.。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-LEVERUP-BOUNDARY`（Leverup：网络、账户与分层连接）规定的具体关系：Provider descriptor 分离 RPC reader、REST reader、Hermes market-data、relayer write 与 catalog leaves。`NetworkIdentity`/`VerifiedNetworkDescriptor` 固定 chain、endpoint identities、contract/token/catalog/schema revisions、generation；每叶子声明精确 schema 与 availability。`Effect` service R 只表示 scoped transport/signer/resource；current permission witness（AccountScope、principal、policy revision）在 invocation admission 单独解析。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Keep deterministic fixed-key EIP-712 vectors and the fetch/viem fixture speed.；Replace the implication that this proves live relayer or chain behavior with explicit synthetic-evidence language.；本 section 的具体变更为 用 `CredentialRef` 替代 config raw privateKey；signer capability 只在 trusted execution tree 内，public identity 只输出 derived trader address evidence。；RPC、reader、Hermes、relayer 以独立 scoped resource Layers 获取与关闭，记录 generation/health/availability；不让 RPC probe 授权 write。；testnet/live endpoints、catalog、contracts、feed、domain 必须共同验证；生产 URL 不可作为 testnet fallback。；移除 public `PrivateKeyAccount`、PublicClient、raw records、schema setter 与 generic post；barrel 仅导出 safe descriptor/config/codecs/leaves。；将旧 in-memory order map 归 compatibility fixture；controlled effect 使用 shared journal/leases/opaque lookup。。权属：Connection/resource owner 管理 Effect service R、timeout/cancel/reconnect；仅 controlled effects 由 UTA writer 管理 permission witness、plan/attempt/receipt/recovery，public/account data 不取得该 authority。；public/account data reads 各自有 scope 与 Pull coverage，不进入交易 reservation。；网络 generation/revision 变化使新的 admission stale；历史 effect 仍按原 schema/network binding 观察。。切换：先建立 VerifiedNetworkDescriptor 与 scoped Layer，迁移 public/account reads，再迁移 open/close effect。；切换完成后 index 只保留 v2 safe boundary；迁移 callers 后删除 legacy exports，除非已验证 published external boundary 明确要求一个只读投影。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts:1-8](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts#L1-L8)；[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts:1-9](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts#L1-L9) A6 | 按新关系修正 | 来源 services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts:241-267。实际旧字段/行为：Place tests cover three early failures: a non-market order type, an unknown pair, and the
