source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Preserve early MKT/unknown/UNSET rejection behavior and no relayer call on these paths.；Expand validation to prevent unsafe values and preserve named unsupported order semantics rather than silently dropping fields.；本 section 的具体变更为 prepare 需 Complete scoped position/catalog/scale/price/network/schema evidence；把 exact request/derived values、schema digest、policy、expiry 写入 serializable plan。；writer 先 `DispatchPlanned`，再在唯一 attempt/permission/CAS 下写 `DispatchStarted`，然后 sign/POST；调用结束只返回 action-specific Ack/Rejected/Unknown。；response loss/timeout/false status 进入 observation/recovery；原 inputHash/dispatch identity 复用，禁止 schema fallback、new salt 或 blind resend。；close effect 由 scoped `PositionRef {AccountScope, InstrumentId, positionHash, observationRevision}` 编译；whole/partial semantics 独立。；native idempotency/atomicity/finality 未证明时使用 ObserveBeforeRetry 与 explicit compensation grade None/不允许的 policy。；不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。；新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：UTA JournalWriter/approval/permission witness/lease/CAS/outbox 唯一拥有 write authority；relayer client 不持有 durable order state。；reader/Pyth data observations 与 controlled effect records 分离；status GET 只在 known effect identity 下进入 recovery。；ReturnToAgent 若 configured 只保留未发送 intent/evidence/outbox，不创建 relayer dispatch；source fact 不能授权。。切换：先将 protocols codecs/schemas/private signer/relayer behind provider leaves，再接 durable writer and observation jobs。；迁移 old `LeverupBroker.placeOrder/closePosition/getOrder` callers；删除 in-memory order map, mutable schema switch, generic errors and unsupported fake 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Preserve 60000 Pyth fixture, POST inclusion of binary updates, inputHash correlation, and immediate Submitted projection.；Change success=true to a typed Ack and keep order financial state unresolved until fill evidence exists.；本 section 的具体变更为 prepare 需 Complete scoped position/catalog/scale/price/network/schema evidence；把 exact request/derived values、schema digest、policy、expiry 写入 serializable plan。；writer 先 `DispatchPlanned`，再在唯一 attempt/permission/CAS 下写 `DispatchStarted`，然后 sign/POST；调用结束只返回 action-specific Ack/Rejected/Unknown。；response loss/timeout/false status 进入 observation/recovery；原 inputHash/dispatch identity 复用，禁止 schema fallback、new salt 或 blind resend。；close effect 由 scoped `PositionRef {AccountScope, InstrumentId, positionHash, observationRevision}` 编译；whole/partial semantics 独立。；native idempotency/atomicity/finality 未证明时使用 ObserveBeforeRetry 与 explicit compensation grade None/不允许的 policy。；不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。；新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：UTA JournalWriter/approval/permission witness/lease/CAS/outbox 唯一拥有 write authority；relayer client 不持有 durable order state。；reader/Pyth data observations 与 controlled effect records 分离；status GET 只在 known effect identity 下进入 recovery。；ReturnToAgent 若 configured 只保留未发送 intent/evidence/outbox，不创建 relayer dispatch；source fact 不能授权。。切换：先将 protocols codecs/schemas/private signer/relayer behind provider leaves，再接 durable writer and observation jobs。；迁移 old `LeverupBroker.placeOrder/closePosition/getOrder` callers；删除 in-memory order map, mutable schema switch, generic errors and unsupported fake methods。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts:269-301](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts#L269-L301) |

evidence-backed `MarketSession`，无 calendar 时 Unknown；static capabilities 改为 descriptor-derived availability。；估值 reducer 区分 broker-reported、verified same-currency FX 与 policy-approved Estimated revision 只有一个 activation owner，事件证据不能越级授权。。切换：先实现 Pull schemas/coverage and observations，再迁移 account/position/quote/clock projections。；删除 silent continue、zero volume/PnL、synthetic bid/ask、page0-only The broker starts nested and can mutate to flat after a failure.。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT`（Leverup：受控 open/close、relayer acknowledgement 与恢复）规定的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Preserve the nested-vs-flat differential vector and close field hashing vector as codec regression evidence.；Intentionally remove runtime nested-then-flat fallback and document equal close digest as insufficient protocol proof.；本 section 的具体变更为 prepare 需 Complete scoped position/catalog/scale/price/network/schema evidence；把 exact request/derived values、schema digest、policy、expiry 写入 serializable plan。；writer 先 `DispatchPlanned`，再在唯一 attempt/permission/CAS 下写 `DispatchStarted`，然后 sign/POST；调用结束只返回 action-specific Ack/Rejected/Unknown。；response loss/timeout/false status 进入 observation/recovery；原 inputHash/dispatch identity 复用，禁止 schema fallback、new salt 或 blind resend。；close effect 由 scoped `PositionRef {AccountScope, InstrumentId, positionHash, observationRevision}` 编译；whole/partial semantics 独立。；native idempotency/atomicity/finality 未证明时使用 ObserveBeforeRetry 与 explicit compensation grade None/不允许的 policy。；不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。；新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：UTA JournalWriter/approval/permission witness/lease/CAS/outbox 唯一拥有 write authority；relayer client 不持有 durable order state。；reader/Pyth data observations 与 controlled effect records 分离；status GET 只在 known effect identity 下进入 recovery。；ReturnToAgent 若 configured 只保留未发送 intent/evidence/outbox，不创建 relayer dispatch；source fact 不能授权。。切换：先将 protocols codecs/schemas/private signer/relayer behind provider leaves，再接 durable writer and observation jobs。；迁移 old `LeverupBroker.placeOrder/closePosition/getOrder` callers；删除 in-memory order map, mutable schema switch, generic errors and unsupported fake methods。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts:488-552](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts#L488-L552) |

| <a id="map-d1a1d77a33"></a>[MAP-D1A1D77A33](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Leverup/analyses.json) | [LVENUE-LEVERUP-BOUNDARY](legacy-accommodation.md#lvenue-leverup-boundary) · A2, A3, A4, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 来源 services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts:1-9。实际旧字段/行为：The module is presented as a thin legacy IBroker adapter around signing, relayer submission, and polling, with wallet funds and relayer/Pyth fees described in comments.。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-LEVERUP-BOUNDARY`（Leverup：网络、账户与分层连接）规定的具体关系：Provider descriptor 分离 RPC reader、REST reader、Hermes market-data、relayer write 与 catalog leaves。`NetworkIdentity`/`VerifiedNetworkDescriptor` 固定 chain、endpoint identities、contract/token/catalog/schema revisions、generation；每叶子声明精确 schema 与 availability。`Effect` service R 只表示 scoped transport/signer/resource；current permission witness（AccountScope、principal、policy revision）在 invocation admission 单独解析。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Preserve the documented division between reader, signer, relayer, and polling roles.；Replace prose capability claims with a typed, versioned manifest and explicit unavailable states.；本 section 的具体变更为 用 `CredentialRef` 替代 config raw privateKey；signer capability 只在 trusted execution tree 内，public identity 只输出 derived trader address evidence。；RPC、reader、Hermes、relayer 以独立 scoped resource Layers 获取与关闭，记录 generation/health/availability；不让 RPC probe 授权 write。；testnet/live endpoints、catalog、contracts、feed、domain 必须共同验证；生产 URL 不可作为 testnet fallback。；移除 public `PrivateKeyAccount`、PublicClient、raw records、schema setter 与 generic post；barrel 仅导出 safe descriptor/config/codecs/leaves。；将旧 in-memory order map 归 compatibility fixture；controlled effect 使用 shared journal/leases/opaque lookup。。权属：Connection/resource owner 管理 Effect service R、timeout/cancel/reconnect；仅 controlled effects 由 UTA writer 管理 permission witness、plan/attempt/receipt/recovery，public/account data 不取得该 authority。；public/account data reads 各自有 scope 与 Pull coverage，不进入交易 reservation。；网络 generation/revision 变化使新的 admission stale；历史 effect 仍按原 schema/network binding 观察。。切换：先建立 VerifiedNetworkDescriptor 与 scoped Layer，迁移 public/account reads，再迁移 open/close effect。；切换完成后 index 只保留 v2 safe boundary；迁移 callers 后删除 legacy exports，除非已验证 published external boundary 明确要求一个只读投影。。 明确 supersession：旧 candidate 中的 global action map/universal IBroker 不进入新能力树；只发布该 provider 实际声明的叶子，结构上不存在的 namespace 不补 Unsupported handler。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts:1-9](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts#L1-L9) |

positionHash, observationRevision}` 编译；whole/partial semantics 独立。；native idempotency/atomicity/finality 未证明时使用 ObserveBeforeRetry 与 explicit compensation grade None/不允许的 policy。；不从候选文档或旧 enum `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：UTA JournalWriter/approval/permission witness/lease/CAS/outbox 唯一拥有 write authority；relayer client 不持有 durable order state。；reader/Pyth data observations 与 controlled effect records 分离；status GET 只在 known effect identity 下进入 recovery。；ReturnToAgent 若 configured 只保留未发送 intent/evidence/outbox，不创建 relayer 保留 | 来源 services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts:450-492。实际旧字段/行为：getOrders iterates the process-local orderTracking Map. getOrder returns null for unknown ids; for Submitted records it GETs relayer status, maps executed+success to Filled with txnHash, executed+failure to Inactive with reason, swallows status errors, and otherwise keeps Submitted.。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT`（Leverup：受控 open/close、relayer acknowledgement 与恢复）规定的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 Preserve Submitted pending projection, txnHash/reason diagnostic fields, and legacy null for a genuinely complete unknown lookup.；Intentionally remove Map-only authority, swallowed status errors, and boolean-&gt;Filled/Inactive mapping without evidence.；本 section 的具体变更为 prepare 需 Complete scoped position/catalog/scale/price/network/schema evidence；把 exact request/derived values、schema digest、policy、expiry 写入 serializable plan。；writer 先 `DispatchPlanned`，再在唯一 attempt/permission/CAS 下写 `DispatchStarted`，然后 sign/POST；调用结束只返回 action-specific Ack/Rejected/Unknown。；response loss/timeout/false status 进入 observation/recovery；原 inputHash/dispatch identity 复用，禁止 schema fallback、new salt 或 blind resend。；close effect 由 scoped `PositionRef {AccountScope, InstrumentId, positionHash, observationRevision}` 编译；whole/partial semantics 独立。；native idempotency/atomicity/finality 未证明时使用 ObserveBeforeRetry 与 explicit compensation grade None/不允许的 policy。；不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。；新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。。权属：UTA JournalWriter/approval/permission witness/lease/CAS/outbox 唯一拥有 write authority；relayer client 不持有 durable order state。；reader/Pyth data observations 与 controlled effect records 分离；status GET 只在 known effect identity 下进入 recovery。；ReturnToAgent 若 configured 只保留未发送 intent/evidence/outbox，不创建 relayer dispatch；source fact 不能授权。。切换：先将 protocols codecs/schemas/private signer/relayer behind provider leaves，再接 durable writer and observation jobs。；迁移 old `LeverupBroker.placeOrder/closePosition/getOrder` callers；删除 in-memory order map, mutable schema switch, generic errors and unsupported fake methods。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts:450-492](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts#L450-L492) |

witness、plan/attempt/receipt/recovery，public/account data 不取得该 authority。；public/account data reads 各自有 scope 与 Pull coverage，不进入交易 reservation。；网络 generation/revision 变化使新的 admission stale；历史 effect 仍按原 schema/network binding 观察。。切换：先建立 VerifiedNetworkDescriptor 与 scoped Layer，迁移 public/account reads，再迁移 open/close effect。；切换完成后 index 只保留 v2 safe boundary；迁移 callers 后删除 legacy exports，除非已验证 published external boundary ### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-2FF2A5B544 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> The relayer duplicate-submit/idempotency scope and inputHash retention horizon are not documented in the source and require native evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：A market BUY is priced from the mocked Pyth response, serialized with quantity/price/amountIn scales, posted to the relayer, and immediately exposed as a Submitted order keyed by inputHash. The test also checks the Pyth binary appears in the POST.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the native prerequisite: a versioned relayer conformance observation must establish duplicate-submit scope, inputHash lookup behavior, and retention horizon. Until then, the controlled open effect uses local commandId+payloadDigest uniqueness to return the existing durable receipt for an identical command and IdempotencyConflict for a changed digest; after DispatchStarted or response loss the same dispatch remains Unknown/RecoveryRequired and only observe-before-retry is permitted, never blind resubmission.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-2FF2A5B544 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> The accepted EIP-712 schema, chain finality, and semantic meaning of a Pyth binary update are not established by the local fixtures; absent evidence, the plan stops at Ack/Unknown and does not claim execution.

原始问题对应旧行为：A market BUY is priced from the mocked Pyth response, serialized with quantity/price/amountIn scales, posted to the relayer, and immediately exposed as a Submitted order keyed by inputHash. The test also checks the Pyth binary appears in the POST.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the native prerequisite for accepted primary type, protocol version, chain finality, and the binary update’s on-chain semantic effect. Before that evidence, the open signing leaf is unavailable, Pyth bytes remain bounded evidence attached to the frozen intent, and a valid submit is Ack/Submitted only; Ack, executed/success booleans, or binary presence cannot become Filled, Confirmed, or final.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-A2A0451C27 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6**

> Whether LeverUp's native close endpoint supports partial quantity is not evidenced by this source and must remain unavailable until a documented/empirical capability is captured.

原始问题对应旧行为：Close resolves a pair, reads mocked open positions, returns an error for unknown pair/no position, and for one matching position posts a close request and reports immediate Submitted success with its inputHash.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the native partial-close capability prerequisite. Until a typed endpoint record or controlled native observation proves Units semantics, no Units/partial-close leaf is published; the compatibility adapter maps an omitted legacy quantity to the explicit close-all leaf because the native endpoint has no amount field, while a supplied quantity is rejected before DispatchStarted with no relayer call. The close-all Ack remains pending until scoped status and residual-exposure evidence.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-B9BAFEC82F · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A3, A4**

> The source does not document the units for open/execution/funding/holding fee strings beyond their decimal encoding; keep their currency/scale unavailable until observed.

原始问题对应旧行为：Account reads combine a six-decimal chain balance with a REST position record; the fixture expects a 1000-USDC balance and a BTC long position with mapped quantity/margin fields.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-READS` 的具体关系：Public Pyth/Instrument/quote/session 是 finite Pull；account balance/positions/order facts 是 AccountScope-bound Pull。`PriceObservation` 保留 feed、exact integer/exponent/Decimal、confidence、publish/fetch、freshness、`quoteShape: SingleSourceMid` 与 update evidence；`PositionListing` 保留 all statuses/pages/coverage/cursor；`CashObservation` 使用 CurrencyMetadata/Money。所有 data leaves 只需要 Connection/Reader/Hermes R，不取得 transaction permission。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the fee-unit observation prerequisite per field. Until currency, scale, token identity, and as-of are decoded, preserve each raw value as FeeEvidence with FeeUnitUnknown, exclude it from balance/equity/PnL aggregation, and do not replace it with numeric zero; a valid six-decimal USDC balance remains independently queryable as account-bound data.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-A3B8CD6164 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A4, A5, A6, A8**

> The relayer API's exact semantics for executed/success, status retention, and transaction finality are not evidenced by source; native conformance evidence is required.

原始问题对应旧行为：After a place call the test obtains the in-memory inputHash record, then a configured status response can change it from Submitted to Filled; an unknown id returns null.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the native status/finality prerequisite. Until a versioned policy supplies terminal meaning plus execution/fill identity and retention behavior, classify only evidence-supported Acked/StillWorking/Unknown, keep failed GET or unproven absence as Unknown, and never project Filled, Rejected, Committed, or finality from executed/success alone.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-B100B9C54C · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> The source does not identify which primary type the live relayer accepts; schema capability remains unavailable until native protocol evidence is recorded.

原始问题对应旧行为：The tests establish that nested and flat open schemas produce different signatures, while nested and flat close schemas happen to sign the same fields and produce equal signatures. The broker starts nested and can mutate to flat after a failure.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the accepted-primary-type prerequisite for the relevant signing leaf. Until a relayer/contract known-vector or equivalent native evidence binds one SchemaCapability and domain fingerprint before preparation, that leaf is SchemaCapabilityUnavailable; the selected intent is immutable and a post-DispatchStarted or ambiguous result cannot trigger nested-to-flat retry.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-50F0F7A825 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A5, A6, A8**

> The source proves only bytes32 formatting; any relayer deduplication or salt-retention guarantee remains unavailable and cannot be inferred from local uniqueness.

原始问题对应旧行为：`generateOpenSalt` hashes Date.now plus Math.random, and the test checks the result has a bytes32-like format and that two immediate calls differ.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain only the external relayer guarantee as empirical. The controlled open effect binds OpenNonce/salt to scope, command, plan digest, and deployment, replays the same durable identity, and sends post-dispatch ambiguity to observation without allocating a new salt; no native deduplication or retention claim is made.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-D1A1D77A33 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A6, A8**

> The source comment does not provide a protocol version, accepted EIP-712 primary type, relayer idempotency/retention guarantee, status terminal semantics, chain finality rule, complete reader coverage, or fee units; all such manifest features must remain Unavailable/Unknown until independent native evidence is recorded.

原始问题对应旧行为：The module is presented as a thin legacy IBroker adapter around signing, relayer submission, and polling, with wallet funds and relayer/Pyth fees described in comments.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-BOUNDARY` 的具体关系：Provider descriptor 分离 RPC reader、REST reader、Hermes market-data、relayer write 与 catalog leaves。`NetworkIdentity`/`VerifiedNetworkDescriptor` 固定 chain、endpoint identities、contract/token/catalog/schema revisions、generation；每叶子声明精确 schema 与 availability。`Effect` service R 只表示 scoped transport/signer/resource；current permission witness（AccountScope、principal、policy revision）在 invocation admission 单独解析。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Record the manifest conformance prerequisite as fixed outer metadata plus provider-declared leaf fields. Until independently versioned evidence fills each field, public data leaves may remain available with explicit coverage while account/trading leaves report named availability; observations remain Unknown unless evidence supports StillWorking/Rejected, fee fields stay unaggregated, and no finality or retry guarantee is asserted.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-5E91CFA930 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A6, A8**

> The source only proves an RPC chainId probe; reader/relayer health probes, scope-directory semantics, accepted schema, and address-set checks require separate evidence. Until then initialization can expose read-only/degraded capability but must not advertise write readiness.

原始问题对应旧行为：Initialization creates the signer account from the configured key, instantiates relayer and reader clients, calls only publicClient.getChainId, sets initialized, and logs the wallet address.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-BOUNDARY` 的具体关系：Provider descriptor 分离 RPC reader、REST reader、Hermes market-data、relayer write 与 catalog leaves。`NetworkIdentity`/`VerifiedNetworkDescriptor` 固定 chain、endpoint identities、contract/token/catalog/schema revisions、generation；每叶子声明精确 schema 与 availability。`Effect` service R 只表示 scoped transport/signer/resource；current permission witness（AccountScope、principal、policy revision）在 invocation admission 单独解析。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the separate runtime-evidence prerequisite. Initialization may expose public/read-only or degraded capability while reader/relayer health, account scope for account-bound leaves, accepted schema, and address-set evidence are missing; it emits ScopeDiscoveryPending, EndpointIdentityUnavailable, or SchemaCapabilityUnavailable where applicable and never opens a trading leaf from a healthy RPC or wallet address alone.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-5EDC8088C6 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6**

> Source does not establish the live collateral/token mapping, leverage semantics, or zero TP/SL protocol meaning for every listed pair; keep unavailable until native evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：The adapter fetches Pyth for the pair feed, chooses long for BUY, hardcodes USDC and LVUSD token addresses, computes `amountIn = qty * price` at 1x, and encodes amount/qty/price/TP/SL using 6/10/18 decimal helpers.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the per-instrument native mapping prerequisite. Until collateral/token, leverage, zero-protection, and pairBase/deployment semantics are evidenced for the exact deployment and pair, the open leaf returns CollateralTokenUnknown, QuoteConversionUnavailable, ProtectionEncodingUnavailable, or NativeIdentityUnverified as applicable; it does not send hardcoded USDC/LVUSD, infer 1x, or interpret zero TP/SL as None without a named provider capability. Placeholder pairBase rows such as 500BTC/500ETH remain catalog-only. The controlled plan also keeps commit criterion/precondition/compensation evidence explicit and records native no-undo as None(reason) rather than claiming reversibility.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-6786905A37 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> The live accepted schema variant and protocol version are not documented; this remains unavailable until external/native evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：The broker generates a time/random salt, sets a deadline about 300 seconds ahead, puts OpenDataInput/trader/salt/deadline in a message, and signs according to mutable nested/flat state.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the accepted schema/protocol-version prerequisite for the signing leaves. Until SchemaCapability is bound to ChainDeployment before signing, the affected leaf is unavailable with SchemaUnavailable; open deadline and OpenNonce, or close positionHash/deadline without an OpenNonce, remain frozen, and any post-start ambiguity is observed/recovered rather than sent under another schema.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-AFEC8DA518 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A4, A5, A6, A8**

> Relayer duplicate-submit behavior, inputHash retention, and lookup guarantees are absent from the source; native evidence is required before retry/idempotency claims.

原始问题对应旧行为：The signed request is serialized with decimal fields as strings plus Pyth bytes, posted to the relayer, and on any returned inputHash the broker inserts a Submitted record in a Map and returns success=true. Any thrown error is caught and represented as a string failure.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the external retry/idempotency prerequisite for the controlled relayer effect. Before evidence, the JournalWriter owns one stable DispatchStarted/ObserveJob identity and post-boundary timeout, 503, or response loss is Unknown/RecoveryRequired; no second POST, salt, schema, or lookup assumption is allowed. A future native guarantee may narrow this policy only through a versioned adapter evidence record.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-B53E29D3CC · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6**

> Native partial-close support and close status/finality semantics are not present in this source; remain unavailable pending native evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：Close resolves the display pair, fetches open positions, selects the first row whose pairBase matches, ignores the requested close quantity, signs positionHash/deadline, posts close, and returns a Submitted-like response. It does not add the result to orderTracking.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain both native prerequisites. Until proven, Units/partial close has no provider leaf and a supplied legacy quantity is rejected before DispatchStarted, while an omitted quantity is mapped to explicit close-all because the native endpoint has no amount field. Close-all can submit only from a complete scope-bound positionHash before-image; its Ack is pending and cannot become Closed until status plus residual-exposure evidence establishes outcome/finality.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-123F8DBC3D · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A3, A4**

> Fee currency/scale and a reliable net-liquidation source are not documented in this file; native observation is required.

原始问题对应旧行为：The account query runs balance and position reads in parallel, maps the balance as six-decimal USDC, sums margin, subtracts funding/holding fee strings, and returns approximate USD net liquidation with realized PnL set to zero.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-READS` 的具体关系：Public Pyth/Instrument/quote/session 是 finite Pull；account balance/positions/order facts 是 AccountScope-bound Pull。`PriceObservation` 保留 feed、exact integer/exponent/Decimal、confidence、publish/fetch、freshness、`quoteShape: SingleSourceMid` 与 update evidence；`PositionListing` 保留 all statuses/pages/coverage/cursor；`CashObservation` 使用 CurrencyMetadata/Money。所有 data leaves 只需要 Connection/Reader/Hermes R，不取得 transaction permission。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the native fee and net-liquidation observation prerequisite. Until it exists, preserve independently scoped balance/position/fee facts and report Valuation Partial/Unavailable; do not use approximate net liquidation, unqualified fee subtraction, or default zero realized PnL as a risk or execution precondition.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-0233341AE8 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A3, A4, A8**

> REST pagination consistency and exact fee/PnL units are not evidenced; retain raw fields and require native evidence before valuation claims.

原始问题对应旧行为：The query obtains raw open positions, resolves pairBase against the static registry, silently skips rows with unknown pair, converts qty/entry/margin, uses entry price as market price and margin as market value, sets multiplier to one, and sets unrealized/realized PnL to zero.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-READS` 的具体关系：Public Pyth/Instrument/quote/session 是 finite Pull；account balance/positions/order facts 是 AccountScope-bound Pull。`PriceObservation` 保留 feed、exact integer/exponent/Decimal、confidence、publish/fetch、freshness、`quoteShape: SingleSourceMid` 与 update evidence；`PositionListing` 保留 all statuses/pages/coverage/cursor；`CashObservation` 使用 CurrencyMetadata/Money。所有 data leaves 只需要 Connection/Reader/Hermes R，不取得 transaction permission。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the reader conformance prerequisite. Until page totals/cursors are validated across the declared account-bound listing and fee/PnL units are decoded, ReaderPort returns Partial/Unavailable rather than absence, retains every raw/unknown row and unit evidence, and valuation remains unavailable; no entry, margin, zero, or inferred multiplier may fill the gap.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-5D7C69A184 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A4, A5, A6, A8**

> Relayer status retention, namespace listing, and terminal/finality semantics are unavailable from source and need native evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：getOrders iterates the process-local orderTracking Map. getOrder returns null for unknown ids; for Submitted records it GETs relayer status, maps executed+success to Filled with txnHash, executed+failure to Inactive with reason, swallows status errors, and otherwise keeps Submitted.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT` 的具体关系：只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the native listing/status prerequisite. Until native conformance supplies retention, covered namespaces, and terminal/finality meaning, durable controlled-effect refs observe by inputHash, missing or failed status is Unknown, incomplete enumeration is Partial, and booleans cannot yield Filled, Cancelled, Rejected, or absence.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-481A2438E0 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A8**

> The source contains no bid/ask/volume feed and no verified freshness, session, or finality policy; those fields stay unavailable and stale observations cannot authorize writes.

原始问题对应旧行为：The quote query resolves a pair, fetches Pyth, converts the price to a number, sets bid/ask/last equal, volume to zero, and timestamp to publishTime; BrokerError is rethrown through a generic catch mapper.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-READS` 的具体关系：Public Pyth/Instrument/quote/session 是 finite Pull；account balance/positions/order facts 是 AccountScope-bound Pull。`PriceObservation` 保留 feed、exact integer/exponent/Decimal、confidence、publish/fetch、freshness、`quoteShape: SingleSourceMid` 与 update evidence；`PositionListing` 保留 all statuses/pages/coverage/cursor；`CashObservation` 使用 CurrencyMetadata/Money。所有 data leaves 只需要 Connection/Reader/Hermes R，不取得 transaction permission。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the missing external observation/policy prerequisite while closing the source-level fabrication question: expose exact mark through QuoteShape=MarkOnly with VolumeUnavailable until corresponding feeds exist; stale/future/malformed observations are typed data failures and cannot authorize a trading leaf, and no session/finality fact is inferred from a quote.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

> No LeverUp venue calendar/session source is present; MarketSession remains Unknown and write admission is blocked until a versioned calendar/evidence source exists.

Until configured or observed venue-session evidence exists, return MarketSession.Unknown/SessionUnknown and a session-dependent trading leaf cannot be admitted; never use the legacy always-open response as an execution precondition. A future calendar must carry source, version, scope where applicable, and freshness.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-4AD307691B · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3**

> Per-instrument deployment support and accepted schema evidence are absent; static CRYPTO_PERP/MKT labels cannot become usable capability without context.

原始问题对应旧行为：The broker returns a static AccountCapabilities object advertising only CRYPTO_PERP security type and MKT order type, without account, deployment, schema, or evidence metadata.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-BOUNDARY` 的具体关系：Provider descriptor 分离 RPC reader、REST reader、Hermes market-data、relayer write 与 catalog leaves。`NetworkIdentity`/`VerifiedNetworkDescriptor` 固定 chain、endpoint identities、contract/token/catalog/schema revisions、generation；每叶子声明精确 schema 与 availability。`Effect` service R 只表示 scoped transport/signer/resource；current permission witness（AccountScope、principal、policy revision）在 invocation admission 单独解析。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the per-instrument/deployment/schema evidence prerequisite. Until a capability snapshot binds the relevant scope (only for account-bound leaves), InstrumentId, ChainDeployment, SchemaCapability, and revision, CRYPTO_PERP/MKT remain compatibility metadata and the affected write leaf is Unavailable with an explicit reason; no DispatchStarted may be created from static lists.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-96C363D9C7 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> The live relayer's accepted primary schema is undocumented; variant selection remains unavailable until evidence is collected.

Until one immutable SchemaCapability is evidenced before prepare, signing is blocked with SchemaUnavailable; changing a prepared variant is forbidden and any post-start ambiguity creates observation/recovery work rather than a second schema submission.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-BC7663242A · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A6**

> The reader API's pagination consistency, total-page guarantees, and fee-unit semantics are not established by this source; keep completeness/valuation conservative until native evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：The helper exposes raw reader records after initialization, with no schema decode, pagination completeness, account-scope binding, or retention policy at this boundary.。当前 section `LVENUE-LEVERUP-BOUNDARY` 的具体关系：Provider descriptor 分离 RPC reader、REST reader、Hermes market-data、relayer write 与 catalog leaves。`NetworkIdentity`/`VerifiedNetworkDescriptor` 固定 chain、endpoint identities、contract/token/catalog/schema revisions、generation；每叶子声明精确 schema 与 availability。`Effect` service R 只表示 scoped transport/signer/resource；current permission witness（AccountScope、principal、policy revision）在 invocation admission 单独解析。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain the reader conformance prerequisite. Two booleans cannot distinguish pending, rejected, still working, malformed, and unknown reachability.。当前 section 关系：`LVENUE-PROTOCOL-RELAYER`（LeverupProtocols：Relayer acknowledgement、status 与 durable polling）规定的具体关系：为 open/close/status 分别声明 exact request/success/failure/observation schemas；`RemoteOutcome = Confirmed\|Rejected\|StillWorking\|Unknown` 只用于有 known effect identity 的 controlled observation。`post<T>` 被 provider-specific action leaves 取代；HTTP effect 持有 endpoint generation/timeout/cancel/size policy，writer 负责 Dispatch barriers 与 recovery。。保留/改变后果：旧契约中应保留的可观察行为为 before POST；DispatchStarted 是唯一 mutation boundary。；POST response decode 为 typed Ack；GET status 关联 `OpaqueLookupRef` 与 expected effect identity，保留 as-of/endpoint generation。；用 durable observation job/checkpoint/lease/backoff 取代 in-memory timer；failure 后不能 Completed，status item error 与 terminal outcome 分开。；response loss/timeout/transport unknown 观察原 inputHash；native idempotency unproven 时 observe-before-retry，不生成新 POST。；controlled plan/contract/command 使用目标 canonicalization：RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、full 64-hex 与 domain-separated/versioned digest；本窄协议 fixture 只记录设计前提，不宣称已实现该持久 writer。。权属：HTTP client/transport timer/cancel 属于 Relayer Effect R；writer 的 command identity/permission/recovery 属于 UTA。；status query 若非 controlled effect 仅是 data observation，不自动拿 AccountScope 或交易 lock。；只有 fresh writer Start 可发出 process-bound one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 仅返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，persisted authorization 不可重放。。切换：按 action/status 拆 exact codecs/adapter Effects，再让 Leverup effect leaf 使用 durable scheduler。；删除 generic post/casts, timer-synthetic status, boolean failure mapping and in-memory submission authority。。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/relayer-client.ts:13-52](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/relayer-client.ts#L13-L52) |

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-63F62A28BF · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3**

> Authoritative scales for non-USDC collateral and every high-leverage pair are not present here; obtain them before advertising capability.

原始问题对应旧行为：The module exposes three unscoped numeric constants. The broker applies quantity and price scales to every pair and assumes collateral is USDC.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-UNITS` 的具体关系：定义 field-tagged `NativeIntegerSpec {scale,signedness,width,rounding,field}`，边界 `DecimalString` 解析与 exact bigint codec；输出只能是 `Quantity<InstrumentId>`、`Price<InstrumentId,QuoteCurrency>` 或 `Money<CurrencyCode>`。`InstrumentDescriptor`/`CollateralAsset` 带 NetworkIdentity、TokenAddress、TokenDecimals、revision/source/as-of；`Constraint` 在 construction 同时绑定 validator、descriptor、digest。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain authoritative scale evidence as empirical. QTY/PRICE/USDC constants remain candidate provider facts; a field-tagged declaration must prove instrument/collateral scale before publishing a dependent leaf, with no inherited six-decimal fallback or signing.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-93BB15270F · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A6**

> The deployed contract rounding rule is not established here; compatibility policy needs protocol evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：decimalToWei accepts Decimal or arbitrary string, truncates extra precision toward zero, and returns bigint; malformed values throw.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-UNITS` 的具体关系：定义 field-tagged `NativeIntegerSpec {scale,signedness,width,rounding,field}`，边界 `DecimalString` 解析与 exact bigint codec；输出只能是 `Quantity<InstrumentId>`、`Price<InstrumentId,QuoteCurrency>` 或 `Money<CurrencyCode>`。`InstrumentDescriptor`/`CollateralAsset` 带 NetworkIdentity、TokenAddress、TokenDecimals、revision/source/as-of；`Constraint` 在 construction 同时绑定 validator、descriptor、digest。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain deployed rounding semantics as empirical. The provider numeric declaration must bind an explicit rounding policy; absent protocol evidence, RejectPrecisionLoss is the safe effect policy and ROUND_DOWN is not a universal default.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-CA68AA9D2A · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4**

> Units for REST fields beyond qty/price require authoritative response evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：weiToDecimal accepts bigint or arbitrary decimal string and callers decide whether the value is qty, price, or collateral.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-UNITS` 的具体关系：定义 field-tagged `NativeIntegerSpec {scale,signedness,width,rounding,field}`，边界 `DecimalString` 解析与 exact bigint codec；输出只能是 `Quantity<InstrumentId>`、`Price<InstrumentId,QuoteCurrency>` 或 `Money<CurrencyCode>`。`InstrumentDescriptor`/`CollateralAsset` 带 NetworkIdentity、TokenAddress、TokenDecimals、revision/source/as-of；`Constraint` 在 construction 同时绑定 validator、descriptor、digest。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain REST units as empirical. Decode only qty/price fields whose units are evidenced; preserve fee/PnL and other raw values with UnresolvedUnit/Unavailable provenance, never guess scale or aggregate them.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-B6898CEF97 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4**

> Future product scales require deployed catalog evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：Any supplied quantity uses ten decimals and no instrument or field descriptor is required.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-UNITS` 的具体关系：定义 field-tagged `NativeIntegerSpec {scale,signedness,width,rounding,field}`，边界 `DecimalString` 解析与 exact bigint codec；输出只能是 `Quantity<InstrumentId>`、`Price<InstrumentId,QuoteCurrency>` 或 `Money<CurrencyCode>`。`InstrumentDescriptor`/`CollateralAsset` 带 NetworkIdentity、TokenAddress、TokenDecimals、revision/source/as-of；`Constraint` 在 construction 同时绑定 validator、descriptor、digest。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain future product scales as empirical. An instrument without deployed catalog and field evidence remains unavailable for the dependent leaf and cannot reuse the current quantity scale.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-EB598077BB · 由主机契约决定 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6**

> Exact confidence/freshness thresholds are market policy decisions.

原始问题对应旧行为：Price conversion is fixed at 18 decimals and has no quote currency, instrument, oracle source, confidence, or freshness.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-UNITS` 的具体关系：定义 field-tagged `NativeIntegerSpec {scale,signedness,width,rounding,field}`，边界 `DecimalString` 解析与 exact bigint codec；输出只能是 `Quantity<InstrumentId>`、`Price<InstrumentId,QuoteCurrency>` 或 `Money<CurrencyCode>`。`InstrumentDescriptor`/`CollateralAsset` 带 NetworkIdentity、TokenAddress、TokenDecimals、revision/source/as-of；`Constraint` 在 construction 同时绑定 validator、descriptor、digest。。本题裁决为 `resolved-by-host-contract`：Close the policy-shape question by requiring a bound, versioned Leverup price policy declaration for any effect that consumes a price. Proposal values are examples only, not maintainer approval or provider SLA; public price pulls remain independent data results.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-98D8B226B2 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6**

> Whether LVUSD or another collateral is accepted per network is not established here.

原始问题对应旧行为：The helper is generic only by decimal count while open compilation chooses USDC and six decimals; reverse conversion decodes cash and margin the same way.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-UNITS` 的具体关系：定义 field-tagged `NativeIntegerSpec {scale,signedness,width,rounding,field}`，边界 `DecimalString` 解析与 exact bigint codec；输出只能是 `Quantity<InstrumentId>`、`Price<InstrumentId,QuoteCurrency>` 或 `Money<CurrencyCode>`。`InstrumentDescriptor`/`CollateralAsset` 带 NetworkIdentity、TokenAddress、TokenDecimals、revision/source/as-of；`Constraint` 在 construction 同时绑定 validator、descriptor、digest。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain network/account collateral acceptance as empirical. USDC is usable only with matching token metadata and provider evidence; LVUSD/other assets remain unavailable until the relevant declared effect leaf is evidenced.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-A8F11986D4 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> Canonical primary types and relayer acceptance are unavailable in this repository and block write capability.

原始问题对应旧行为：The source exports both open and close schema families and leaves the selected variant as mutable adapter state. The comment describes a fallback/confirmation plan, not a verified protocol fact.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-SCHEMA` 的具体关系：每个 write leaf 有 immutable `SchemaDescriptor`（protocol/version、primary type、field tree、domain shape、semantic/schema digest、schema slot）。Nested/flat 是 distinct candidate/historical versions，不能 per-call switch。pure `compileOpen/compileClose` 输出 canonical encoded request + `RequestDigest`; scoped `SignerCapability` 只签 prepared effect，返回 `SignedNativeRequest {effectId,AttemptId,schemaVersion,digest,signatureRef,trader}`。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain canonical primary type and relayer acceptance as empirical. The affected write leaf stays unavailable without evidence; no response, timeout, or Unknown result selects another schema.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-351C6A94E7 · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> Exact schema library and sealed-byte storage are shared integration choices.

原始问题对应旧行为：These interfaces describe values passed to viem but permit any 0x-prefixed string and bigint. They are exported and can be mistaken for actions or durable request records.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-SCHEMA` 的具体关系：每个 write leaf 有 immutable `SchemaDescriptor`（protocol/version、primary type、field tree、domain shape、semantic/schema digest、schema slot）。Nested/flat 是 distinct candidate/historical versions，不能 per-call switch。pure `compileOpen/compileClose` 输出 canonical encoded request + `RequestDigest`; scoped `SignerCapability` 只签 prepared effect，返回 `SignedNativeRequest {effectId,AttemptId,schemaVersion,digest,signatureRef,trader}`。。本题裁决为 `resolved-by-host-contract`：Adopt the K03/K07 boundary: RuntimeSchemaCodec and bounded sealed references constrain the UTA-facing records, while concrete schema libraries, SDKs, and native records remain adapter implementation choices and do not cross the boundary.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-73F74DC466 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> Deployed code/domain acceptance is external evidence.

原始问题对应旧行为：buildDomain deterministically copies caller values into a const object, but does not prove RPC endpoint, network tag, and deployed agent agree.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-SCHEMA` 的具体关系：每个 write leaf 有 immutable `SchemaDescriptor`（protocol/version、primary type、field tree、domain shape、semantic/schema digest、schema slot）。Nested/flat 是 distinct candidate/historical versions，不能 per-call switch。pure `compileOpen/compileClose` 输出 canonical encoded request + `RequestDigest`; scoped `SignerCapability` 只签 prepared effect，返回 `SignedNativeRequest {effectId,AttemptId,schemaVersion,digest,signatureRef,trader}`。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain deployed code/domain acceptance as empirical. Fixed name/version and configured address are provider candidates only; without matching chain and deployment evidence, the dependent schema/effect leaf remains unavailable.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-518E08C180 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6**

> Deployed primary type and zero-protection semantics are unavailable and block this capability.

原始问题对应旧行为：Nested is the default signer path because a documentation example looked executable, not because a deployed verification is recorded.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-SCHEMA` 的具体关系：每个 write leaf 有 immutable `SchemaDescriptor`（protocol/version、primary type、field tree、domain shape、semantic/schema digest、schema slot）。Nested/flat 是 distinct candidate/historical versions，不能 per-call switch。pure `compileOpen/compileClose` 输出 canonical encoded request + `RequestDigest`; scoped `SignerCapability` 只签 prepared effect，返回 `SignedNativeRequest {effectId,AttemptId,schemaVersion,digest,signatureRef,trader}`。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain nested primary and zero-protection semantics as empirical. Without a known vector/acceptance result, the nested open leaf remains unavailable; zero values are preserved as unverified encoding, not declared no-protection.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-6E2E6F9904 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> No evidence identifies canonical primary type or legitimate multi-version deployment.

原始问题对应旧行为：The flat map is an alternate implementation of the same logical open action and can be activated through SchemaVariant, producing a different type hash.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-SCHEMA` 的具体关系：每个 write leaf 有 immutable `SchemaDescriptor`（protocol/version、primary type、field tree、domain shape、semantic/schema digest、schema slot）。Nested/flat 是 distinct candidate/historical versions，不能 per-call switch。pure `compileOpen/compileClose` 输出 canonical encoded request + `RequestDigest`; scoped `SignerCapability` 只签 prepared effect，返回 `SignedNativeRequest {effectId,AttemptId,schemaVersion,digest,signatureRef,trader}`。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain canonical primary and any legitimate multi-version deployment as empirical. A supported version must be selected before preparation as immutable provider capability evidence; runtime flat/nested toggles and fallback submissions are not allowed.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-A9DB1F677B · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6**

> Close schema and partial-close semantics are unavailable here.

Only an evidence-backed whole-close leaf may be prepared; partial input remains unavailable rather than becoming whole-close behavior.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-12314DC5A5 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A4, A5, A6, A7**

> Relayer/contract salt idempotency is not proven here.

Persist salt and native identity for one controlled effect attempt; without native deduplication evidence, post-boundary Unknown is observed before any retry decision and never gets a new salt blindly.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-CAE8A402AD · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6**

Use it only as an OpaqueLookupRef for status observation, never as transaction/idempotency/fill/finality identity; missing, semantically unknown, or mismatched lookups remain Unknown for a possible sent effect.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-96515A5FA2 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A4, A5, A6, A7**

> Relayer finality/retention and schedule are operational policies.

原始问题对应旧行为：Polling owns an in-memory timer and returns first executed status or a synthetic status after thirty seconds. There is no durable lease/checkpoint/backoff/identity or post-crash continuation.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-RELAYER` 的具体关系：为 open/close/status 分别声明 exact request/success/failure/observation schemas；`RemoteOutcome = Confirmed|Rejected|StillWorking|Unknown` 只用于有 known effect identity 的 controlled observation。`post<T>` 被 provider-specific action leaves 取代；HTTP effect 持有 endpoint generation/timeout/cancel/size policy，writer 负责 Dispatch barriers 与 recovery。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain relayer finality/retention as empirical and require an explicit bound observation policy before scheduling status pulls. Any proposal cadence is not provider SLA; timer expiry never means Rejected, recovery release, or redispatch.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-A283DD30CA · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> Additional relayer headers/authentication are not shown; configuration must provide them without hardcoding secrets.

原始问题对应旧行为：One generic helper handles open and close and trusts caller-selected response types. It has no schema, redaction, deadline/cancel, response bound, or pre/post mutation distinction.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-RELAYER` 的具体关系：为 open/close/status 分别声明 exact request/success/failure/observation schemas；`RemoteOutcome = Confirmed|Rejected|StillWorking|Unknown` 只用于有 known effect identity 的 controlled observation。`post<T>` 被 provider-specific action leaves 取代；HTTP effect 持有 endpoint generation/timeout/cancel/size policy，writer 负责 Dispatch barriers 与 recovery。。本题裁决为 `resolved-by-host-contract`：Adopt the K03/K07 provider request boundary: each present open/close leaf declares exact request/response/error schemas, while concrete auth/header/HTTP implementation remains adapter-local. A failed data pull is not a mutation failure.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-09A529447A · 由主机契约决定 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> Credential service and account-directory APIs are outside types.ts.

原始问题对应旧行为：Public config carries full private key and AccountId/AccountScope are not explicit. Key is parsed only for syntax before deriving viem account.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-DEPLOYMENT` 的具体关系：配置边界解析 non-secret `ConnectionIntent {AccountId, optional SubAccountId, NetworkIntent, CredentialRef}`；部署解码为 `VerifiedNetworkDescriptor`，把 chain/RPC/reader/relayer/Hermes/contracts/tokens/catalog/schema/domain fingerprint 与 generation 绑定。barrel 只导出 provider descriptor、restricted structural schema declarations、safe codecs、scoped Layer 和 declared leaves；native types/secret handles private。。本题裁决为 `resolved-by-host-contract`：Adopt the fixed identity boundary: parse non-secret intent, resolve explicit AccountScope for account facts/effects, and derive only evidenced provider leaves. CredentialRef rotation changes credential generation, not AccountId or historical effect identity; public data needs no fabricated account.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-B24803E3AD · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6**

> Deployment bytecode/version evidence is not in type declaration.

原始问题对应旧行为：NetworkConstants is a raw bag of values; it cannot express whether RPC, services, contracts, and catalog form one coherent deployment or which capabilities are reachable.。当前 section `LVENUE-PROTOCOL-DEPLOYMENT` 的具体关系：配置边界解析 non-secret `ConnectionIntent {AccountId, optional SubAccountId, NetworkIntent, CredentialRef}`；部署解码为 `VerifiedNetworkDescriptor`，把 chain/RPC/reader/relayer/Hermes/contracts/tokens/catalog/schema/domain fingerprint 与 generation 绑定。barrel 只导出 provider descriptor、restricted structural schema declarations、safe codecs、scoped Layer 和 declared leaves；native types/secret handles private。。本题裁决为 `requires-provider-evidence`：Retain deployment bytecode/version as empirical. Raw chain/address/URL values are candidates only; absent deployment or coherence evidence leaves dependent capabilities unavailable and cannot authorize a write.。该裁决仅约束本 provider capability/slot，且不把未验证 native guarantee 推广到其他 provider。

**MAP-7DDADCCAD1 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A4, A5, A6, A7**

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-4A48C821C3 · 由主机契约决定 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8**

> Source inspection found no production caller or persisted configuration requiring a third-party guard extension. The current closed built-in policy therefore rejects undeclared extension types; if another owned group has verified a shipped extension requirement, Main must add a separately versioned composition-root layer contract rather than reopening the untyped registry.

Old source behavior/question: 旧事实/疑问：Any code executing in the process can install or replace a guard factory after module initialization. The factory accepts Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; and returns the string/null OperationGuard, with no action association, schema, capability declaration, version, or durable policy record. 证据：services/uta/src/domain/trading/guards/guards.spec.ts:295-305 exercises custom registration only as a legacy test; no production caller is present in the observed source search.；services/uta/src/domain/trading/guards/registry.ts:6-19 declares exactly max-position-size, cooldown, and symbol-whitelist as built-ins, while registerGuard is the unsafe process-global mutator under replacement.；src/core/config.ts:436-454 persists only raw guard {type, options} entries and defines no third-party extension discriminator or versioned extension variant.；docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k01 and docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k02 require declaration-derived capability metadata and typed composition without a global ActionContractMap or mandatory provider handler set.；docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Guards/analyses.json entry MAP-4A48C821C3 and docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k01 plus docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/composition-contract.md#k02 retain the source finding while routing any future extension through an immutable composition-root descriptor.. Selected relation (LTX-GUARDS): 声明绑定 typed facts/issue/constraint/evaluator 与具体 effect leaf；评价保持纯函数，writer 在当前 scope/version 上原子重检并持有 reservation，未知估值或身份不 fail open。 Consequence: 由本 section 的 host contract 收口；具体 adapter/runtime 参数仍按原始 evidence gate 实现，不新增第二 authority。 Closure decision/evidence retained from the restored record: LTX-GUARDS)：声明绑定 typed facts/issue/constraint/evaluator 与具体 effect leaf；评价保持纯函数，writer 在当前 scope/version 上原子重检并持有 reservation，未知估值或身份不 fail open。 具体后果：由本 section 的 host contract 收口；具体 adapter/runtime 参数仍按原始 evidence gate 实现，不新增第二 authority。 Closure/evidence retained from the restored record: The observed source currently has three built-in guard declarations and no production or persisted third-party extension requirement; its current registry still warns and skips an undeclared type, which is the defect being replaced. The target configuration path must reject an undeclared guard reference atomically as GuardConfigFailure.UnknownRuleType before controlled-effect admission. This is a current composition/availability fact, not a universal closed provider SDK: public data capabilities and provider effect trees remain declaration-specific and open. If independent evidence later establishes a shipped extension, add a separately versioned composition-root RuleDeclaration/Layer with its config, rule input/required facts/pass-fact/issue schemas, effect applicability, and implementation identity; preserve the exact provider leaf input/result/error schemas, bind the immutable snapshot fingerprint to new controlled-effect plans, and retain existing plans or require explicit reprepare. Never restore the untyped process-global registry.. Original investigation evidence: docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Guards/analyses.json, design.md, entries.md, reviews.json, questions-closure.json (original investigation evidence; byte-identical).

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-F64B549F14 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A4, A5, A7, A8**

> 生产历史 journal 是否已有可作为 source sequence 的单调 revision，以及迁移时的 cursor 起点，需在运行数据盘点中确认。

Legacy question/field uncertainty: 生产历史 journal 是否已有可作为 source sequence 的单调 revision，以及迁移时的 cursor 起点，需在运行数据盘点中确认。 Current relation in LSTATE-SNAPSHOT-SCHEDULER: Map the named timer/callback/request behavior to durable SnapshotRequest and supervised scheduler ownership. Preserve cause, ordering, coalescing and cancellation; change fire-and-forget callbacks to explicit capture receipts and nonterminal stream-item semantics. Provider/source evidence remains required; until supplied, the affected value/capability stays quality-marked or Unavailable and cannot authorize execution. Original closure/evidence remains unchanged at docs/uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Snapshots/questions-closure.json entry MAP-F64B549F14; it is retained as investigation evidence, not copied as new source truth.


### 跨组契约与补充发现

> 原调查：services/uta/src/domain/trading/snapshot/types.ts:1-8 明确快照概念上独立于 TradingGit commit 且财务值以 string 保存；目标保留这两个事实，Git head/pending 进入独立 GitAudit component，provider-native metadata 通过 exact declared extension 保存，不让 Git 或 SDK 成为 snapshot authority。

**当前承接：** [LSTATE-SNAPSHOT-MODEL](legacy-accommodation.md#lstate-snapshot-model)。Observed finding retained as original investigation evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/snapshot/types.ts:1-8 明确快照概念上独立于 TradingGit commit 且财务值以 string 保存；目标保留这两个事实，Git head/pending 进入独立 GitAudit component，provider-native metadata 通过 exact declared extension 保存，不让 Git 或 SDK 成为 snapshot authority。 Current relation in LSTATE-SNAPSHOT-MODEL: Decode the named snapshot field into pure SnapshotCaptureResult/SnapshotViewEnvelope. Preserve string decimals, scope, cause, source evidence and no-fabrication; change nullable live assembly to typed coverage/result without making Snapshot an execution authority. Preserve the cited fact/uncertainty and apply only this section-owned change; it does not add a generic kernel entity or provider guarantee. > 原调查：contract: FX and account aggregation; decision: Same-currency conversion is explicit Identity; cross-currency valuation uses directional `FxRateObservation(from,to)` where `amount_to = amount_from × rate`, and returns Confirmed, Estimated/Stale, Unavailable or Invalid. Cross-rate composition requires pair/source/time-policy agreement; account totals are Complete/Partial/Rejected and cannot silently sum unknown currencies or use an unknown 1:1 fallback.; coordination: UtaManager and `/fx-rates` consume ValuationResult; market-data adapters own network/cache and provide actual observation timestamps; policy decides estimate admissibility. Fees remain currency-qualified Money, external balance adjustments are not fills, realized PnL requires confirmed closing fills plus basis policy, and unrealized PnL remains mark-based.

Other providers may expose their own native kinds; only exact, declared mappings yield shared semantics or execution capability, and absence is reported as capability unavailable rather than by a universal handler or closed global taxonomy.

**当前承接：** [LCORE-NATIVE-CODECS](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-native-codecs)。旧事实保留：NativeInstrumentContract: the currently observed IBKR SecType values and structural rules remain in brokers/ibkr codecs, while the UTA-facing Instrument descriptor carries evidence-backed identity/context and precise provider extensions. Other providers may expose their own native kinds; only exact, declared mappings yield shared semantics or execution capability, and absence is reported as capability unavailable rather than by a universal handler or closed global taxonomy.；具体目标关系（Native sentinel、Contract discipline 与精确身份）：Native codec 是 provider-local construction-bound declaration：所有 Decimal/Double/Integer sentinel、presence（包括 false/0/empty）、SecType raw value、kind-specific requirements 和 extension fields 都有精确 encoded schema。InstrumentDescriptor 由 evidence-backed native/listing tuple 建立；UnknownNativeSecType(raw)、InvalidContract、MissingKindField 保留，而不是在 coercion 中静默降级。。
