| <a id="map-41d1b056c8"></a>[MAP-41D1B056C8](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Catalog/analyses.json) | [LCORE-INSTRUMENT-SEARCH](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-instrument-search) · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：search-rules.ts documents that normalization is a deliberately isolated heuristic bridging vendor symbols to broker tickers, and defines AssetClassHint as equity/crypto/currency/commodity/unknown.；本节具体目标关系（搜索规范、来源排序与 Instrument identity）：将纯 `SearchPattern`（原始 symbol、AssetClassHint、query、stripped QuoteCurrency、ruleVersion）与 provider ListingResult 分开。只有 observed venue/listing/native-key evidence 才生成 InstrumentId/InstrumentDescriptor；source precedence、score、tie、dedup、pagination、truncation 和 per-source Complete/Partial/Unavailable 都显式。heuristic 不证明 market existence、scope 或 capability。；保留后果：Preserve centralized heuristic ownership and current identity-vs-symbol caution.；迁移后果：Introduce SearchPattern and normalization-rule version.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede heuristic-as-identity 与 silent source-drop；SearchPattern 只给候选，InstrumentId 必须有 observed listing evidence。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts:1-14。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts:1-14](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts#L1-L14) |
| <a id="map-819a30c052"></a>[MAP-819A30C052](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Catalog/analyses.json) | [LCORE-INSTRUMENT-SEARCH](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-instrument-search) · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：QUOTE_CURRENCIES is an ordered tuple with USDT/USDC/BUSD before USD and a case-insensitive suffix regex requiring a base of at least two alphanumeric characters.；本节具体目标关系（搜索规范、来源排序与 Instrument identity）：将纯 `SearchPattern`（原始 symbol、AssetClassHint、query、stripped QuoteCurrency、ruleVersion）与 provider ListingResult 分开。只有 observed venue/listing/native-key evidence 才生成 InstrumentId/InstrumentDescriptor；source precedence、score、tie、dedup、pagination、truncation 和 per-source Complete/Partial/Unavailable 都显式。heuristic 不证明 market existence、scope 或 capability。；保留后果：Preserve USDT-before-USD ordering, case-insensitive matching, and the two-character base guard.；迁移后果：Define QuoteCurrency and rule-version constants.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede heuristic-as-identity 与 silent source-drop；SearchPattern 只给候选，InstrumentId 必须有 observed listing evidence。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts:16-23。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts:16-23](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts#L16-L23) |
| <a id="map-006af2bf79"></a>[MAP-006AF2BF79](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Catalog/analyses.json) | [LCORE-INSTRUMENT-SEARCH](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-instrument-search) · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：normalizeBrokerSearchPattern trims input, strips a known quote suffix only for crypto/currency, uppercases the base on a match, and otherwise returns the trimmed symbol; equity, commodity, and unknown return identity.；本节具体目标关系（搜索规范、来源排序与 Instrument identity）：将纯 `SearchPattern`（原始 symbol、AssetClassHint、query、stripped QuoteCurrency、ruleVersion）与 provider ListingResult 分开。只有 observed venue/listing/native-key evidence 才生成 InstrumentId/InstrumentDescriptor；source precedence、score、tie、dedup、pagination、truncation 和 per-source Complete/Partial/Unavailable 都显式。heuristic 不证明 market existence、scope 或 capability。；保留后果：Preserve trim, case, suffix order, class-specific behavior, and no heuristic for unknown/equity/commodity.；迁移后果：Implement SearchPattern/result type and adapt `contract-search.ts` callers.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede heuristic-as-identity 与 silent source-drop；SearchPattern 只给候选，InstrumentId 必须有 observed listing evidence。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts:25-55。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts:25-55](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/search-rules.ts#L25-L55) |
| <a id="map-ae04cd83e4"></a>[MAP-AE04CD83E4](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Catalog/analyses.json) | [LCORE-CATALOG-PRESENTATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-catalog-presentation) · A1, A2, A3, A4, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：The protocol barrel describes a long-term public wire package and re-exports all types, schemas, UTA client, broker preset catalog/serialization, and search rules.；本节具体目标关系（展示 schema、公共 barrel 与搜索路由）：`PresetPresentationCatalog`、`SerializedPreset`、`JsonSchemaDocument` 与 runtime `ConnectionIntent` 分离；presentation AST 由受限 structural schema algebra + Zod-derived construction 生成并 versioned，mode labels/writeOnly 是 immutable projection，绝不含 secret values。schemas barrel 提供 versioned probe/scope/search/Draft/Prepare/Approve/Reject/Recover/query envelopes，而不是 global action map。；保留后果：Preserve current client/protocol role and coordinated versioning expectation.；迁移后果：Define explicit `public`, `presentation`, and `runtime-internal` entry points.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede presentation schema as runtime authority；schema parse/metadata success 不等于 readiness/authorization。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/index.ts:1-20。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/index.ts:1-20](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/index.ts#L1-L20) |
| <a id="map-e43dfc70ef"></a>[MAP-E43DFC70EF](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Catalog/analyses.json) | [LCORE-CATALOG-PRESENTATION](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-catalog-presentation) · A1, A2, A3, A4, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：The schemas barrel is intentionally empty while its header promises one Zod Request/Response pair per UTA HTTP endpoint and shared use by client SDK and Hono zValidator.；本节具体目标关系（展示 schema、公共 barrel 与搜索路由）：`PresetPresentationCatalog`、`SerializedPreset`、`JsonSchemaDocument` 与 runtime `ConnectionIntent` 分离；presentation AST 由受限 structural schema algebra + Zod-derived construction 生成并 versioned，mode labels/writeOnly 是 immutable projection，绝不含 secret values。schemas barrel 提供 versioned probe/scope/search/Draft/Prepare/Approve/Reject/Recover/query envelopes，而不是 global action map。；保留后果：Preserve route intent and shared client/server validation.；迁移后果：Inventory every existing UTA route and add one request/response pair under schemas.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede presentation schema as runtime authority；schema parse/metadata success 不等于 readiness/authorization。；来源锚点：packages/uta-protocol/src/schemas/index.ts:1-10。<br>源码：[packages/uta-protocol/src/schemas/index.ts:1-10](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/schemas/index.ts#L1-L10) |
| <a id="map-6367d87808"></a>[MAP-6367D87808](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Catalog/analyses.json) | [LCORE-CATALOG-COMPOSITION](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-catalog-composition) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：factory.ts imports the legacy IBroker type, loadBrokerEngine, getBrokerPreset, UTAConfig, and FxService; its header defines the factory as preset-to-engine resolver and says presetId is the only persisted tie to implementations.；本节具体目标关系（连接组装、FX 要求与模块边界）：`ConnectionAssembler` 输入 typed UTAConfig/ConnectionIntent、exact historical/live resolver、PackLoader、SecretResolver 与 evidence services，输出按 leaf scope 的 `ScopedConnection`/read handle。FxRequirement/FxObservation 是 capability contract 的显式 requirement；提供 Fx Layer 不替代 permission witness。public data leaf 不需默认账户或 FX，account/effect leaf 才声明这些要求。；保留后果：Preserve presetId as the account config linkage and all keyless/read-only distinctions.；迁移后果：Create `ConnectionAssembler` under runtime composition and migrate uta-manager/routes to it.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede generic factory/setter/reflection；resource Layer 不能制造 permission witness，cutover 后只保留 named ports。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts:1-20。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts:1-20](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts#L1-L20) |
| <a id="map-c3b978232c"></a>[MAP-C3B978232C](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Catalog/analyses.json) | [LCORE-CATALOG-COMPOSITION](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-catalog-composition) · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：BrokerServices exposes optional `fxService?: FxService`, allowing callers to provide an FX service independently of broker support.；本节具体目标关系（连接组装、FX 要求与模块边界）：`ConnectionAssembler` 输入 typed UTAConfig/ConnectionIntent、exact historical/live resolver、PackLoader、SecretResolver 与 evidence services，输出按 leaf scope 的 `ScopedConnection`/read handle。FxRequirement/FxObservation 是 capability contract 的显式 requirement；提供 Fx Layer 不替代 permission witness。public data leaf 不需默认账户或 FX，account/effect leaf 才声明这些要求。；保留后果：Preserve Longbridge multi-currency support and skip FX for single-currency brokers.；迁移后果：Add FX requirement to adapter/action capability descriptors.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede generic factory/setter/reflection；resource Layer 不能制造 permission witness，cutover 后只保留 named ports。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts:21-24。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts:21-24](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts#L21-L24) |

| <a id="map-efde4efd6b"></a>[MAP-EFDE4EFD6B](../uta-effect-runtime-design/solutions/Catalog/analyses.json) | [LCORE-CATALOG-PROVIDER-PACKS](legacy-accommodation.md#lcore-catalog-provider-packs) · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8 | 按新关系修正 | 旧字段/行为：registry.spec.ts creates a temporary OPENALICE_HOME, disables workspace packs, resets modules before each test, and recursively removes the temporary home/restores environment afterward.；本节具体目标关系（Provider pack、manifest、缓存与加载失败）：manifest/pointer/package identity/content digest 是 provenance gate；pack descriptor 是 SDK-free、versioned、construction-bound definition，固定 outer metadata 后携带 open provider capability tree。Descriptor certificate 的 provider instance/capability/revision/full semantic/schema digest/schema slot 必须同时匹配；descriptor cache key 含 content/protocol generation，account/connection/journal state 不在 cache。；保留后果：Preserve test isolation, env restoration, module reset, and recursive cleanup.；迁移后果：Replace direct env/fs manipulation in behavior tests with an injected PackStore fixture where possible.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede runtime shim/dual-read 与 independent descriptor metadata；definition/codec/digest/schema slot construction-bound，installed historical resolver 与 live admission 分离。；来源锚点：services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/registry.spec.ts:1-28。<br>源码：[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/registry.spec.ts:1-28](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/registry.spec.ts#L1-L28) |

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-9AD9951502 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> The source does not document whether Alpaca native order submission is idempotent across process restart; adapter must use order identity/reconcile-before-retry until evidence is recorded.

旧字段/行为：index.ts imports AlpacaBroker from services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca, so the released pack directly bundles the legacy IBroker class.；本节具体目标关系（Provider pack、manifest、缓存与加载失败）：manifest/pointer/package identity/content digest 是 provenance gate；pack descriptor 是 SDK-free、versioned、construction-bound definition，固定 outer metadata 后携带 open provider capability tree。Descriptor certificate 的 provider instance/capability/revision/full semantic/schema digest/schema slot 必须同时匹配；descriptor cache key 含 content/protocol generation，account/connection/journal state 不在 cache。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Keep lazy SDK loading: importing the core without an Alpaca pack must still work.；迁移后果：Create a pack-local adapter module and delete the import of the legacy AlpacaBroker.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede runtime shim/dual-read 与 independent descriptor metadata；definition/codec/digest/schema slot construction-bound，installed historical resolver 与 live admission 分离。。

**MAP-607170E22C · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> Alpaca API endpoint/account response fields proving environment and trade permission are not present in this wrapper source; broker adapter evidence must define them.

旧字段/行为：The exported configSchema is AlpacaBroker.configSchema, which accepts optional paper, apiKey, and apiSecret fields from the legacy class.；本节具体目标关系（Provider pack、manifest、缓存与加载失败）：manifest/pointer/package identity/content digest 是 provenance gate；pack descriptor 是 SDK-free、versioned、construction-bound definition，固定 outer metadata 后携带 open provider capability tree。Descriptor certificate 的 provider instance/capability/revision/full semantic/schema digest/schema slot 必须同时匹配；descriptor cache key 含 content/protocol generation，account/connection/journal state 不在 cache。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Keep existing paper/live input names at migration boundary.；迁移后果：Move schema and native codecs into packages/uta-broker-alpaca or services/uta/src/brokers/alpaca.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede runtime shim/dual-read 与 independent descriptor metadata；definition/codec/digest/schema slot construction-bound，installed historical resolver 与 live admission 分离。。

**MAP-6496594BF0 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> Native Alpaca idempotency/lookup horizon and exact partial-fill recovery evidence remain unavailable in this source range.

旧字段/行为：createBroker accepts `{id,label?,brokerConfig: Record<string,unknown>}`, calls AlpacaBroker.fromConfig, then adds `brokerEngine` with Object.assign and returns an IBroker.；本节具体目标关系（Provider pack、manifest、缓存与加载失败）：manifest/pointer/package identity/content digest 是 provenance gate；pack descriptor 是 SDK-free、versioned、construction-bound definition，固定 outer metadata 后携带 open provider capability tree。Descriptor certificate 的 provider instance/capability/revision/full semantic/schema digest/schema slot 必须同时匹配；descriptor cache key 含 content/protocol generation，account/connection/journal state 不在 cache。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Preserve successful Alpaca order translation and paper/live separation.；迁移后果：Implement the descriptor and remove `AlpacaBroker.fromConfig` import from the wrapper.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede runtime shim/dual-read 与 independent descriptor metadata；definition/codec/digest/schema slot construction-bound，installed historical resolver 与 live admission 分离。。

**MAP-B40F4C1C42 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> Exact idempotency scope and completeness/retention horizon differ by exchange and are not established by this wrapper source; each adapter must record evidence before allowing resend.

旧字段/行为：index.ts imports the legacy CcxtBroker class from services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt.；本节具体目标关系（Provider pack、manifest、缓存与加载失败）：manifest/pointer/package identity/content digest 是 provenance gate；pack descriptor 是 SDK-free、versioned、construction-bound definition，固定 outer metadata 后携带 open provider capability tree。Descriptor certificate 的 provider instance/capability/revision/full semantic/schema digest/schema slot 必须同时匹配；descriptor cache key 含 content/protocol generation，account/connection/journal state 不在 cache。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Keep the pack optional and retain CCXT public keyless queries where supported.；迁移后果：Create services/uta/src/brokers/ccxt adapter definition with named exchange config/response codecs.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede runtime shim/dual-read 与 independent descriptor metadata；definition/codec/digest/schema slot construction-bound，installed historical resolver 与 live admission 分离。。

**MAP-F3151B31E7 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A8**

> Required credential subsets and account/sub-account selector semantics are exchange-specific and need per-pack evidence.

旧字段/行为：The wrapper re-exports `CcxtBroker.configSchema`; the legacy schema accepts exchange, sandbox/demo flags, options record, and many optional credential fields.；本节具体目标关系（Provider pack、manifest、缓存与加载失败）：manifest/pointer/package identity/content digest 是 provenance gate；pack descriptor 是 SDK-free、versioned、construction-bound definition，固定 outer metadata 后携带 open provider capability tree。Descriptor certificate 的 provider instance/capability/revision/full semantic/schema digest/schema slot 必须同时匹配；descriptor cache key 含 content/protocol generation，account/connection/journal state 不在 cache。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Preserve exchange-specific optional credential support and keyless public-data use.；迁移后果：Move CCXT schema into adapter package and add per-exchange codecs/credential refs.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede runtime shim/dual-read 与 independent descriptor metadata；definition/codec/digest/schema slot construction-bound，installed historical resolver 与 live admission 分离。。

旧字段/行为：ALPACA_PRESET declares paper/live modes, requires non-empty apiKey/apiSecret, marks both write-only, fingerprints mode+apiKey, and translates mode to engine paper boolean.；本节具体目标关系（Preset、环境提示、凭据引用与账户配置）：拆成 stable `PresetCatalog` presentation 与 typed `ConnectionIntentCodec`：每个 preset 保留 PresetId、provider engine、supported environments、credential refs、account selector、schema/version；Live/Paper/Demo/Testnet/Unknown 是 `TradingEnvironmentHint`，只能与 authenticated `TradingEnvironmentEvidence` 合并后评估 write readiness。SecretRef 不进入 identity digest、descriptor、plan 或 journal；AccountId 是 durable allocated identity，LegacyUtaIdAlias/IdentityBinding 负责迁移。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias` 仅是已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，不能作为 live resolver alias、双读路径或 compatibility shim。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Preserve separate paper/live credential guidance and paper boolean translation for the native adapter boundary.；迁移后果：Introduce the typed Alpaca intent codec and secret-reference fields in the connection record.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede mode/port/network-as-authority 与 live ID alias；环境须有 provider evidence，旧 ID 只离线 import。。

**MAP-DE2769E2F7 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A8**

> The exact IBKR handshake/account-summary fields for environment evidence are adapter-owned and must be specified before implementation.

旧字段/行为：IBKR_PRESET accepts host, numeric port, clientId, and optional accountId; defaults host 127.0.0.1, port 7497, clientId 0, passes those values through, and infers paper from ports 7497/4002.；本节具体目标关系（Preset、环境提示、凭据引用与账户配置）：拆成 stable `PresetCatalog` presentation 与 typed `ConnectionIntentCodec`：每个 preset 保留 PresetId、provider engine、supported environments、credential refs、account selector、schema/version；Live/Paper/Demo/Testnet/Unknown 是 `TradingEnvironmentHint`，只能与 authenticated `TradingEnvironmentEvidence` 合并后评估 write readiness。SecretRef 不进入 identity digest、descriptor、plan 或 journal；AccountId 是 durable allocated identity，LegacyUtaIdAlias/IdentityBinding 负责迁移。 `LegacyUtaIdAlias` 仅是已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping，不能作为 live resolver alias、双读路径或 compatibility shim。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Preserve host/port/clientId pass-through and auto-discovery when accountId is omitted.；迁移后果：Add an IBKR connection-intent codec and evidence-bearing adapter interface.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede mode/port/network-as-authority 与 live ID alias；环境须有 provider evidence，旧 ID 只离线 import。。

**MAP-F45EE8D4C7 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A8**

> Legacy git/sealed-account vectors must be captured from existing records before migration; old deriveUtaId output remains lookup-only and never new identity authority.

旧字段/行为：deriveUtaId tests deterministic same-input hashes, `${preset.id}-${8hex}` shape, object-key-order invariance, ignored non-fingerprint fields, differing fingerprint values/presets, null normalization, and Mock `_instanceId` uniqueness.；本节具体目标关系（展示 schema、公共 barrel 与搜索路由）：`PresetPresentationCatalog`、`SerializedPreset`、`JsonSchemaDocument` 与 runtime `ConnectionIntent` 分离；presentation AST 由受限 structural schema algebra + Zod-derived construction 生成并 versioned，mode labels/writeOnly 是 immutable projection，绝不含 secret values。schemas barrel 提供 versioned probe/scope/search/Draft/Prepare/Approve/Reject/Recover/query envelopes，而不是 global action map。；问题处置：该事实保持 provider-evidence gap；在证据出现前只允许本节定义的 unavailable/unknown 或查询边界，不能提升为 native guarantee。；保留后果：Preserve exact old hash outputs for backward lookup and object-key-order behavior where legacy records require it.；迁移后果：Mark old deriveUtaId vectors as legacy compatibility fixtures.；明确取舍：本次选择 supersede presentation schema as runtime authority；schema parse/metadata success 不等于 readiness/authorization。。

### 原始问题及本设计处置

**MAP-4D4A864108 · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A5, A6**

> The source does not prove whether the Bybit adapter returns parent-linked TP/SL legs for this request; acceptance must obtain a venue capability/observation fixture before claiming bracket confirmation.

旧事实：TPSL prices are derived with JS Number/Math.round, passed as optional takeProfit/stopLoss, then order is optionally fetched and closed.。当前章节关系：provider-specific Controlled effect leaf 保留 exact native extension、ack/observation/recovery evidence，不宣称跨 provider guarantee。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：['services/uta/src/domain/trading/__test__/e2e/ccxt-bybit.e2e.spec.ts:140-184', '../composition-contract.md#k02', '../composition-contract.md#k03', '../composition-contract.md#k04', '../composition-contract.md#k07', '../composition-contract.md#k08', 'entries.md#map-4d4a864108']。当前 host decision：Retain the empirical prerequisite. The Bybit bracket leaf may preserve exact provider TP/SL parameters and Decimal/tick provenance, but bracket-confirmed requires both declared capability evidence and a parent-linked leg observation fixture. Until then emit ProtectionCapabilityAbsent or BracketObservationUnknown and keep uncertain cleanup in the controlled-effect RecoveryCase.

**MAP-E5356E684D · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7**

> The source does not establish whether the venue trigger query exposes a stable native identity after cache invalidation; adapter observation coverage is required.

旧事实：A generic buy is followed by raw conditional sell trigger creation, internal `orderSymbolCache` mutation, getOrder/cancel, then close.。当前章节关系：provider-specific Controlled effect leaf 保留 exact native extension、ack/observation/recovery evidence，不宣称跨 provider guarantee。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：['services/uta/src/domain/trading/__test__/e2e/ccxt-bybit.e2e.spec.ts:186-234', '../composition-contract.md#k02', '../composition-contract.md#k07', '../composition-contract.md#k08', '../composition-contract.md#k09', 'entries.md#map-e5356e684d']。当前 host decision：Retain the empirical prerequisite. Trigger identity is provider/adapter evidence, not a global cache contract. After cache invalidation, if no stable native identity is observed, preserve Unknown and block takeover/cancel; do not infer UTA dispatch or cleanup success.

**MAP-A60C86B58F · 仍需 Provider 证据 · A1, A2, A5, A6**

> The source does not prove Hyperliquid execution/fill latency or stablecoin normalization across all account modes; live acceptance must supply observed execution and currency-policy evidence.

旧事实：Places a 0.001 BTC perp market buy, expects success/orderId, optionally validates execution, then reads BTC position and USD normalization.。当前章节关系：provider-specific Controlled effect leaf 保留 exact native extension、ack/observation/recovery evidence，不宣称跨 provider guarantee。原始调查证据（originalInvestigationEvidence）：['services/uta/src/domain/trading/__test__/e2e/ccxt-hyperliquid.e2e.spec.ts:97-129', '../composition-contract.md#k03', '../composition-contract.md#k04', '../composition-contract.md#k05', '../composition-contract.md#k08', 'entries.md#map-a60c86b58f']。当前 host decision：Retain the empirical prerequisite. The Hyperliquid order.place effect admits 0.001 BTC only with versioned quote/minimum-notional capability evidence; Ack does not prove fill. The deterministic test-owned identity/dedup behavior belongs to the fixture; neither seam is live-venue durability or native-idempotency evidence, and neither changes the provider capability contract.. Selected relation (LTX-POLLING): provider-declared observation leaves 保存 OrderRef、scope、coverage、cursor/checkpoint、freshness 与 lookup evidence；durable job/lease/backoff 由 root scheduler 管理，普通数据和 controlled effect 不共享 authority。 Consequence: 在 provider/runtime evidence 到位前保持 empirical Unknown/OperatorRequired，采用该 section 的保守分支，不以默认值补齐。 Closure decision/evidence retained from the restored record: LTX-POLLING)：provider-declared observation leaves 保存 OrderRef、scope、coverage、cursor/checkpoint、freshness 与 lookup evidence；durable job/lease/backoff 由 root scheduler 管理，普通数据和 controlled effect 不共享 authority。 具体后果：在 provider/runtime evidence 到位前保持 empirical Unknown/OperatorRequired，采用该 section 的保守分支，不以默认值补齐。 Closure/evidence retained from the restored record: Keep OrderRef lookup descriptors, freshness and execution identity as provider evidence fields. A null lookup without absence proof, unknown retention/freshness, or missing stable execution identity remains StillWorking/Unknown/OperatorRequired; MockBroker nulls and mock-ord-N values cannot produce cancellation, rejection, or native identity guarantees.. The selected accommodation correctly treats those as migration facts, separates authenticated principal/scope/revision/digest from the product policy input, and routes both manual and configured-auto execution through the controlled-effect writer rather than exposing broker access. Account lifecycle remains a separate typed capability：its command validates expectedConfigRevision and delegates persisted config/secret mutation to the existing Alice owner；UTA applies the authorized revision to connections/readiness/recovery and does not create a new config store. The migration removes direct broker mutation bypass, not Alice's config owner, and no claim is made that the target boundary is already implemented. The source gap is retained at the Alice/UTA trust boundary, but the target is a composed set of authenticated lifecycle, query, and controlled-effect capability leaves. Approval binding belongs only to effect leaves; account identity, capability availability, and presentation correlation remain separate rather than becoming a universal broker contract.. Selected relation (LTX-BRIDGE): authenticated UTA service binding、typed lifecycle/effect command 与 review/control CAS 承接 edge 请求；configured policy 仍必须经过 Prepare/Approval/Writer/DispatchStarted，Alice/connector/CLI 只持有 receipt、delivery 或 read handles。 Consequence: 按上述 relation 收窄旧候选的边界与安全分支，保留 source fields/uncertainty，移除不受证据支持的默认保证。 Retained closure/source evidence: LTX-BRIDGE): authenticated UTA service binding、typed lifecycle/effect command 与 review/control CAS 承接 edge 请求；configured policy 仍必须经过 Prepare/Approval/Writer/DispatchStarted，Alice/connector/CLI 只持有 receipt、delivery 或 read handles。 Consequence: 按上述 relation 收窄旧候选的边界与安全分支，保留 source fields/uncertainty，移除不受证据支持的默认保证. ### 原始问题及本设计处置
